+private struct PayloadScan {
+  var objects: [Any] = []
+  var queryKeys = Set<String>()
+  var urlScheme: String?
+  var urlHost: String?
+
+  init(payloadData: Data, summaryData: Data) {
+    objects.append(contentsOf: PayloadScanner.objects(from: payloadData))
+    objects.append(contentsOf: PayloadScanner.objects(from: summaryData))
+
+    var facts = PayloadScannerFacts()
+    for object in objects {
+      PayloadScanner.collect(from: object, facts: &facts, depth: 0)
+    }
+
+    let nestedObjects = facts.data.flatMap { PayloadScanner.objects(from: $0) }
+    objects.append(contentsOf: nestedObjects)
+    for object in nestedObjects {
+      PayloadScanner.collect(from: object, facts: &facts, depth: 0)
+    }
+
+    for string in facts.strings {
+      if let url = PayloadScanner.url(from: string) {
+        facts.urls.append(url)
+      }
+    }
+
+    for url in facts.urls {
+      captureMetadata(from: url)
+      if let dataPayload = PayloadScanner.dataURLPayload(from: url) {
+        objects.append(contentsOf: PayloadScanner.embeddedObjects(from: dataPayload))
+      }
+      guard let components = URLComponents(url: url, resolvingAgainstBaseURL: false) else {
+        continue
+      }
+      for item in components.queryItems ?? [] {
+        queryKeys.insert(item.name)
+        guard let value = item.value else { continue }
+        objects.append(contentsOf: PayloadScanner.embeddedObjects(from: value))
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  private mutating func captureMetadata(from url: URL) {
+    if urlScheme == nil {
+      urlScheme = url.scheme
+    }
+    if urlHost == nil {
+      urlHost = url.host
+    }
+  }
+
+  var hasPollURLHint: Bool {
+    [urlScheme, urlHost].contains { value in
+      value?.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains("poll") == true
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+private struct PayloadScannerFacts {
+  var strings: [String] = []
+  var urls: [URL] = []
+  var data: [Data] = []
+  var visitedNodes = 0
+}
+
+private enum PayloadScanner {
+  static func objects(from data: Data) -> [Any] {
+    guard !data.isEmpty else { return [] }
+    var objects: [Any] = []
+
+    if let object = try? NSKeyedUnarchiver.unarchivedObject(
+      ofClasses: allowedArchiveClasses,
+      from: data
+    ) {
+      objects.append(object)
+    }
+
+    if let plist = try? PropertyListSerialization.propertyList(
+      from: data,
+      options: [],
+      format: nil
+    ) {
+      objects.append(plist)
+      if let resolved = KeyedArchiveResolver.resolve(plist) {
+        objects.append(resolved)
+      }
+    }
+
+    if let json = try? JSONSerialization.jsonObject(with: data, options: []) {
+      objects.append(json)
+    }
+
+    if let string = String(data: data, encoding: .utf8) {
+      objects.append(string)
+      objects.append(contentsOf: embeddedObjects(from: string))
+    }
+
+    return objects
+  }
+
+  static func embeddedObjects(from value: String) -> [Any] {
+    let decoded = value.removingPercentEncoding ?? value
+    var objects: [Any] = []
+    if let data = decoded.data(using: .utf8) {
+      objects.append(contentsOf: structuredObjects(from: data))
+    }
+    if let data = base64Data(from: decoded) {
+      objects.append(contentsOf: Self.objects(from: data))
+    }
+    return objects
+  }
+
+  static func collect(from value: Any, facts: inout PayloadScannerFacts, depth: Int) {
+    guard depth < 32, facts.visitedNodes < 20_000 else { return }
+    facts.visitedNodes += 1
+
+    if let url = value as? URL {
+      facts.urls.append(url)
+      return
+    }
+    if let url = value as? NSURL {
+      facts.urls.append(url as URL)
+      return
+    }
+    if let string = value as? String {
+      facts.strings.append(string)
+      return
+    }
+    if let data = value as? Data {
+      facts.data.append(data)
+      return
+    }
+    if let dict = stringDictionary(value) {
+      for child in dict.values {
+        collect(from: child, facts: &facts, depth: depth + 1)
+      }
+      return
+    }
+    if let array = arrayValue(value) {
+      for child in array {
+        collect(from: child, facts: &facts, depth: depth + 1)
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  static func url(from value: String) -> URL? {
+    let trimmed = value.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
+    guard trimmed.count <= 65_536,
+      let components = URLComponents(string: trimmed),
+      components.scheme != nil
+    else {
+      return nil
+    }
+    return components.url ?? URL(string: trimmed)
+  }
+
+  static func dataURLPayload(from url: URL) -> String? {
+    guard url.scheme?.lowercased() == "data" else { return nil }
+    let absolute = url.absoluteString
+    guard let comma = absolute.firstIndex(of: ",") else { return nil }
+    let payloadStart = absolute.index(after: comma)
+    let end =
+      absolute[payloadStart...].firstIndex(where: { $0 == "?" || $0 == "#" })
+      ?? absolute.endIndex
+    guard payloadStart < end else { return nil }
+    let payload = String(absolute[payloadStart..<end])
+    return payload.removingPercentEncoding ?? payload
+  }
+
+  private static func structuredObjects(from data: Data) -> [Any] {
+    var objects: [Any] = []
+    if let json = try? JSONSerialization.jsonObject(with: data, options: []) {
+      objects.append(json)
+    }
+    if let plist = try? PropertyListSerialization.propertyList(
+      from: data,
+      options: [],
+      format: nil
+    ) {
+      objects.append(plist)
+      if let resolved = KeyedArchiveResolver.resolve(plist) {
+        objects.append(resolved)
+      }
+    }
+    return objects
+  }
+
+  private static func base64Data(from value: String) -> Data? {
+    let compact = value.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
+    guard compact.count >= 8 else { return nil }
+    guard
+      compact.allSatisfy({ character in
+        character.isLetter || character.isNumber || character == "+" || character == "/"
+          || character == "-" || character == "_" || character == "="
+      })
+    else {
+      return nil
+    }
+    var normalized = compact.replacingOccurrences(of: "-", with: "+")
+      .replacingOccurrences(of: "_", with: "/")
+    let remainder = normalized.count % 4
+    if remainder > 0 {
+      normalized += String(repeating: "=", count: 4 - remainder)
+    }
+    return Data(base64Encoded: normalized)
+  }
+
+  private static let allowedArchiveClasses: [AnyClass] = [
+    NSArray.self,
+    NSDictionary.self,
+    NSString.self,
+    NSNumber.self,
+    NSData.self,
+    NSDate.self,
+    NSURL.self,
+    NSUUID.self,
+    NSNull.self,
+  ]
+}
+
+private enum KeyedArchiveResolver {
+  static func resolve(_ plist: Any) -> Any? {
+    guard let archive = stringDictionary(plist),
+      let objects = arrayValue(archive["$objects"]),
+      let top = stringDictionary(archive["$top"])
+    else {
+      return nil
+    }
+    let rootUID =
+      top["root"].flatMap(uidValue)
+      ?? top.values.compactMap(uidValue).first
+    guard let rootUID else { return nil }
+    var seen = Set<Int>()
+    return resolveObject(at: rootUID, objects: objects, seen: &seen, depth: 0)
+  }
+
+  private static func resolveObject(
+    at index: Int,
+    objects: [Any],
+    seen: inout Set<Int>,
+    depth: Int
+  ) -> Any? {
+    guard index > 0, index < objects.count, depth < 32 else { return nil }
+    if seen.contains(index) { return nil }
+    seen.insert(index)
+    defer { seen.remove(index) }
+    return resolveValue(objects[index], objects: objects, seen: &seen, depth: depth + 1)
+  }
+
+  private static func resolveValue(
+    _ value: Any,
+    objects: [Any],
+    seen: inout Set<Int>,
+    depth: Int
+  ) -> Any? {
+    if let uid = uidValue(value) {
+      return resolveObject(at: uid, objects: objects, seen: &seen, depth: depth + 1)
+    }
+    if value is NSNull { return nil }
+    if let string = value as? String { return string }
+    if let number = value as? NSNumber { return number }
+    if let data = value as? Data { return data }
+    if let date = value as? Date { return date }
+
+    if let array = arrayValue(value) {
+      return array.compactMap { child in
+        resolveValue(child, objects: objects, seen: &seen, depth: depth + 1)
+      }
+    }
+
+    guard let dict = stringDictionary(value) else { return value }
+
+    if let relative = dict["NS.relative"] {
+      let resolvedRelative =
+        resolveValue(
+          relative,
+          objects: objects,
+          seen: &seen,
+          depth: depth + 1
+        ) as? String
+      if let base = dict["NS.base"],
+        let baseString = resolveValue(base, objects: objects, seen: &seen, depth: depth + 1)
+          as? String,
+        let relative = resolvedRelative,
+        let baseURL = URL(string: baseString)
+      {
+        return URL(string: relative, relativeTo: baseURL)?.absoluteString ?? relative
+      }
+      return resolvedRelative
+    }
+
+    if let keys = arrayValue(dict["NS.keys"]), let values = arrayValue(dict["NS.objects"]) {
+      var resolved: [String: Any] = [:]
+      for (rawKey, rawValue) in zip(keys, values) {
+        guard
+          let key = resolveValue(rawKey, objects: objects, seen: &seen, depth: depth + 1)
+            as? String
+        else {
+          continue
+        }
+        if let value = resolveValue(rawValue, objects: objects, seen: &seen, depth: depth + 1) {
+          resolved[key] = value
+        }
+      }
+      return resolved
+    }
+
+    if let values = arrayValue(dict["NS.objects"]) {
+      return values.compactMap { child in
+        resolveValue(child, objects: objects, seen: &seen, depth: depth + 1)
+      }
+    }
+
+    var resolved: [String: Any] = [:]
+    for (key, rawValue) in dict
+    where key != "$class" && key != "$classes" && key != "$classname" {
+      if let value = resolveValue(rawValue, objects: objects, seen: &seen, depth: depth + 1) {
+        resolved[key] = value
+      }
+    }
+    return resolved
+  }
+
+  private static func uidValue(_ value: Any) -> Int? {
+    let description = String(describing: value)
+    guard let marker = description.range(of: "value = ") else { return nil }
+    var digits = ""
+    for character in description[marker.upperBound...] {
+      guard character.isNumber else { break }
+      digits.append(character)
+    }
+    return Int(digits)
+  }
+}
+
+private func arrayValue(_ value: Any?) -> [Any]? {
+  guard let value else { return nil }
+  if let array = value as? [Any] { return array }
+  if let array = value as? NSArray { return array.map { $0 } }
+  return nil
+}
+
+private func stringDictionary(_ value: Any?) -> [String: Any]? {
+  guard let value else { return nil }
+  if let dict = value as? [String: Any] { return dict }
+  guard let dict = value as? NSDictionary else { return nil }
+  var result: [String: Any] = [:]
+  for (key, value) in dict {
+    guard let key = key as? String else { continue }
+    result[key] = value
+  }
+  return result
+}

--- /dev/null
+++ b/Sources/IMsgCore/MessageStore+Polls.swift
@@ -0,0 +1,68 @@
+import SQLite
+
+extension MessageStore {
+  func enrichedPollEvent(
+    _ poll: MessagePollEvent?,
+    db: Connection,
+    cache: inout PollOptionTextCache
+  ) throws -> MessagePollEvent? {
+    guard let poll, poll.kind == .vote else { return poll }
+    let candidateGUIDs = [poll.originalGUID, poll.pollGUID]
+      .compactMap { value -> String? in
+        guard let value else { return nil }
+        let normalized = normalizeAssociatedGUID(value)
+        return normalized.isEmpty ? nil : normalized
+      }
+    guard let pollGUID = candidateGUIDs.first else { return poll }
+
+    let optionTexts = try pollOptionTextsByID(
+      pollGUID: pollGUID,
+      db: db,
+      cache: &cache
+    )
+    return poll.resolvingVoteOptionTexts(optionTexts)
+  }
+
+  private func pollOptionTextsByID(
+    pollGUID: String,
+    db: Connection,
+    cache: inout PollOptionTextCache
+  ) throws -> [String: String] {
+    if let cached = cache.optionsByPollGUID[pollGUID] {
+      return cached
+    }
+    if cache.missingPollGUIDs.contains(pollGUID) {
+      return [:]
+    }
+
+    let selection = MessageRowSelection(store: self, includeChatID: false)
+    let sql = """
+      SELECT \(selection.selectList)
+      FROM message m
+      LEFT JOIN handle h ON m.handle_id = h.ROWID
+      WHERE m.guid = ?
+      LIMIT 1
+      """
+    let rows = try db.prepareRowIterator(sql, bindings: [pollGUID])
+    guard let row = try rows.failableNext() else {
+      cache.missingPollGUIDs.insert(pollGUID)
+      return [:]
+    }
+    let decoded = try decodeMessageRow(
+      row,
+      columns: selection.columns,
+      fallbackChatID: nil
+    )
+    guard let options = decoded.poll?.options, !options.isEmpty else {
+      cache.missingPollGUIDs.insert(pollGUID)
+      return [:]
+    }
+
+    var optionTexts: [String: String] = [:]
+    for option in options where optionTexts[option.id] == nil {
+      optionTexts[option.id] = option.text
+    }
+    cache.optionsByPollGUID[pollGUID] = optionTexts
+    return optionTexts
+  }
+}

+static NSData *pollPreviewImageData(void) {
+    NSBitmapImageRep *rep =
+        [[NSBitmapImageRep alloc] initWithBitmapDataPlanes:NULL
+                                                pixelsWide:162
+                                                pixelsHigh:162
+                                             bitsPerSample:8
+                                           samplesPerPixel:4
+                                                  hasAlpha:YES
+                                                  isPlanar:NO
+                                            colorSpaceName:NSDeviceRGBColorSpace
+                                               bytesPerRow:0
+                                              bitsPerPixel:0];
+    if (!rep) return nil;
+
+    NSGraphicsContext *context = [NSGraphicsContext graphicsContextWithBitmapImageRep:rep];
+    if (!context) return nil;
+    [NSGraphicsContext saveGraphicsState];
+    [NSGraphicsContext setCurrentContext:context];
+
+    [[NSColor colorWithCalibratedRed:0.96 green:0.96 blue:0.98 alpha:1.0] setFill];
+    NSRectFill(NSMakeRect(0, 0, 162, 162));
+
+    [[NSColor colorWithCalibratedRed:0.16 green:0.40 blue:0.86 alpha:1.0] setFill];
+    NSBezierPath *badge = [NSBezierPath bezierPathWithRoundedRect:NSMakeRect(25, 25, 112, 112)
+                                                          xRadius:24
+                                                          yRadius:24];
+    [badge fill];
+
+    [[NSColor whiteColor] setFill];
+    for (NSInteger i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
+        CGFloat y = 103 - (i * 28);
+        [[NSBezierPath bezierPathWithOvalInRect:NSMakeRect(48, y, 10, 10)] fill];
+        NSBezierPath *line = [NSBezierPath bezierPathWithRoundedRect:NSMakeRect(68, y + 1, 46, 8)
+                                                             xRadius:4
+                                                             yRadius:4];
+        [line fill];
+    }
+
+    [NSGraphicsContext restoreGraphicsState];
+    return [rep representationUsingType:NSBitmapImageFileTypeJPEG
+                             properties:@{NSImageCompressionFactor: @0.82}];
+}

+static NSData *archivePollPayloadEnvelope(NSURL *url,
+                                          NSUUID *sessionIdentifier,

+    NSData *previewImage = pollPreviewImageData();

+                                           code:1

+    NSData *liveLayoutInfo = archivePollLiveLayoutInfo(&layoutError);
+    if (!liveLayoutInfo.length) {
+        if (outError) *outError = layoutError;

+    }

+    NSError *capabilitiesError = nil;
+    NSData *requiredCapabilities = archivePollRequiredCapabilities(&capabilitiesError);
+    if (!requiredCapabilities.length) {
+        if (outError) *outError = capabilitiesError;
+        return nil;

+    NSDictionary *userInfo = @{
+        @"caption": previewText,

+        @"image-subtitle": @"",
+        @"subcaption": @"",
+        @"image-title": @"",
+        @"secondary-subcaption": @""

+        @"userInfo": userInfo,

+        @"layoutClass": @"MSMessageTemplateLayout",
+        @"ai": previewImage,
+        @"sessionIdentifier": sessionIdentifier,

+        @"requiredCapabilities": requiredCapabilities,
+        @"sendAsText": @YES,
+        @"an": @"Polls"

+                                     requiringSecureCoding:NO
+                                                     error:outError];

+    #pragma clang diagnostic pop

+static NSData *buildPollCreationPayloadData(NSString *question,
+                                            NSArray<NSString *> *options,
+                                            NSString *creatorHandle,
+                                            NSString **outSessionIdentifier,
+                                            NSArray<NSString *> **outOptionIdentifiers,
+                                            NSString **outError) {
+    NSMutableArray<NSDictionary *> *pollOptions = [NSMutableArray array];
+    NSMutableArray<NSString *> *optionIdentifiers = [NSMutableArray array];
+    for (NSString *optionText in options) {
+        NSString *identifier = [[NSUUID UUID] UUIDString];
+        [optionIdentifiers addObject:identifier];
+        NSMutableDictionary *option = [NSMutableDictionary dictionaryWithDictionary:@{
+            @"canBeEdited": @NO,
+            @"attributedText": optionText,
+            @"text": optionText,
+            @"optionIdentifier": identifier
+        }];
+        if (creatorHandle.length) {
+            option[@"creatorHandle"] = creatorHandle;
+        }
+        [pollOptions addObject:option];
+    }
+
+    NSMutableDictionary *item = [NSMutableDictionary dictionaryWithDictionary:@{
+        @"title": question ?: @"",
+        @"orderedPollOptions": pollOptions
+    }];
+    if (creatorHandle.length) {
+        item[@"creatorHandle"] = creatorHandle;
+    }
+    NSDictionary *root = @{@"item": item, @"version": @1};
+
+    NSError *jsonError = nil;
+    NSData *jsonData = [NSJSONSerialization dataWithJSONObject:root options:0 error:&jsonError];
+    if (!jsonData) {
+        if (outError) *outError = jsonError.localizedDescription ?: @"Could not encode poll payload";
+        return nil;
+    }
+    if (jsonData.length > 4096) {
+        if (outError) *outError = @"Poll definition payload exceeds 4096 bytes";
+        return nil;
+    }
+
+    NSString *encoded = [jsonData base64EncodedStringWithOptions:0];
+    NSString *urlString = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"data:,%@?src=p&c=%lu",
+                                                     encoded,
+                                                     (unsigned long)options.count];
+    NSURL *url = [NSURL URLWithString:urlString];
+    if (!url) {
+        if (outError) *outError = @"Could not create poll URL";
+        return nil;
+    }
+
+    NSUUID *sessionIdentifier = [NSUUID UUID];
+    NSError *archiveError = nil;
+    NSData *payload = archivePollPayloadEnvelope(url, sessionIdentifier, &archiveError);
+    if (!payload) {
+        if (outError) *outError = archiveError.localizedDescription ?: @"Could not archive poll payload";
+        return nil;
+    }
+
+    if (outSessionIdentifier) {
+        *outSessionIdentifier = sessionIdentifier.UUIDString;
+    }
+    if (outOptionIdentifiers) {
+        *outOptionIdentifiers = optionIdentifiers;
+    }
+    return payload;
+}

+static NSString *threadOriginatorPartForChatItem(id parentItem) {
+    if (!parentItem
+        || ![parentItem respondsToSelector:@selector(messagePartRange)]) {
+        return nil;
+    }
+    NSRange range = [(IMMessagePartChatItem *)parentItem messagePartRange];
+    if (range.length == 0) return nil;
+
+    NSInteger partIndex = 0;
+    SEL indexSel = @selector(index);
+    if ([parentItem respondsToSelector:indexSel]) {
+        NSMethodSignature *sig = [parentItem methodSignatureForSelector:indexSel];
+        if (sig && strcmp(sig.methodReturnType, @encode(NSInteger)) == 0) {
+            NSInvocation *inv = [NSInvocation invocationWithMethodSignature:sig];
+            [inv setSelector:indexSel];
+            [inv setTarget:parentItem];
+            [inv invoke];
+            [inv getReturnValue:&partIndex];
+        }
+    }
+
+    return [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%ld:%lu:%lu",
+                                      (long)partIndex,
+                                      (unsigned long)range.location,
+                                      (unsigned long)range.length];
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,99 @@
+import Commander
+import Foundation
+import IMsgCore
+
+enum PollCommand {
+  static let spec = CommandSpec(
+    name: "poll",
+    abstract: "Send a native Apple Messages poll",
+    discussion: """
+      Requires `imsg launch` (SIP-disabled, dylib injected). Use the `send`
+      action to create a native Messages Polls extension balloon.
+      """,
+    signature: CommandSignatures.withRuntimeFlags(
+      CommandSignature(
+        arguments: [
+          .make(label: "action", help: "send", isOptional: false)
+        ],
+        options: CommandSignatures.baseOptions() + [
+          .make(label: "chat", names: [.long("chat")], help: "chat guid or rowid"),
+          .make(label: "chatID", names: [.long("chat-id")], help: "chat rowid"),
+          .make(label: "question", names: [.long("question")], help: "poll question"),
+          .make(label: "replyTo", names: [.long("reply-to")], help: "guid of message to reply to"),
+          .make(
+            label: "option", names: [.long("option")],
+            help: "poll option text; pass at least twice"),
+        ]
+      )
+    ),
+    usageExamples: [
+      "imsg poll send --chat 'iMessage;-;+15551234567' --question 'Dinner?' --option 'Pizza' --option 'Sushi'",
+      "imsg poll send --chat 'iMessage;-;+15551234567' --reply-to ABCD --question 'Approve?' --option 'Yes' --option 'No'",
+    ]
+  ) { values, runtime in
+    try await run(values: values, runtime: runtime)
+  }
+
+  static func run(
+    values: ParsedValues,
+    runtime: RuntimeOptions,
+    storeFactory: @escaping (String) throws -> MessageStore = { try MessageStore(path: $0) },
+    invokeBridge: @escaping (BridgeAction, [String: Any]) async throws -> [String: Any] = {
+      action, params in
+      try await IMsgBridgeClient.shared.invoke(action: action, params: params)
+    }
+  ) async throws {
+    guard values.argument(0) == "send" else {
+      throw ParsedValuesError.invalidOption("action")
+    }
+    let chat = try resolveChatGUID(values: values, storeFactory: storeFactory)
+    guard let question = values.option("question"), !question.isEmpty else {
+      throw ParsedValuesError.missingOption("question")
+    }
+    let options = values.optionValues("option")
+      .map { $0.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines) }
+      .filter { !$0.isEmpty }
+    guard options.count >= 2 else {
+      throw ParsedValuesError.missingOption("option")
+    }
+
+    var params: [String: Any] = [
+      "chatGuid": chat,
+      "question": question,
+      "options": options,
+    ]
+    if let reply = values.option("replyTo"), !reply.isEmpty {
+      params["selectedMessageGuid"] = reply
+    }
+
+    _ = try await BridgeOutput.invokeAndEmit(
+      action: .sendPoll,
+      params: params,
+      runtime: runtime,
+      invokeBridge: invokeBridge
+    ) { data in
+      let guid = (data["messageGuid"] as? String) ?? ""
+      return guid.isEmpty ? "poll: queued" : "poll: sent (guid=\(guid))"
+    }
+  }
+
+  private static func resolveChatGUID(
+    values: ParsedValues,
+    storeFactory: (String) throws -> MessageStore
+  ) throws -> String {
+    let chatValue = values.option("chat")?.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines) ?? ""
+    let chatID = values.optionInt64("chatID") ?? Int64(chatValue)
+    if let chatID {
+      let dbPath = values.option("db") ?? MessageStore.defaultPath
+      let store = try storeFactory(dbPath)
+      guard let info = try store.chatInfo(chatID: chatID) else {
+        throw IMsgError.chatNotFound(chatID: chatID)
+      }
+      return info.guid.isEmpty ? info.identifier : info.guid
+    }
+    guard !chatValue.isEmpty else {
+      throw ParsedValuesError.missingOption("chat")
+    }
+    return chatValue
+  }
+}

+private final class Box<T>: @unchecked Sendable {
+  private let lock = NSLock()
+  private var value: T
+  init(_ value: T) { self.value = value }
+  func withValue<R>(_ body: (inout T) -> R) -> R {
+    lock.lock()
+    defer { lock.unlock() }
+    return body(&value)
+  }
+}

+/// A handle to a running `imsg` subprocess: the shipped CLI itself,
+/// exercised over argv, stdin, and stdout.
+private final class IMsgProcess: @unchecked Sendable {
+  private let executable: URL
+  private let arguments: [String]
+  private let environment: [String: String]
+
+  private var process: Process?
+  private var stderrData = Data()
+  private var stdinPipe: Pipe?
+
+  init(
+    arguments: [String],
+    environment: [String: String] = [:]
+  ) throws {
+    let testBundle = URL(fileURLWithPath: CommandLine.arguments[0]).deletingLastPathComponent()
+    // The test bundle lives in .build/<triple>/debug/; the executable is
+    // built into the same directory. Iterate upward past both split layouts.
+    var candidates: [URL] = [testBundle.appendingPathComponent("imsg")]
+    var probe = testBundle
+    for _ in 0..<8 {
+      probe.deleteLastPathComponent()
+      candidates.append(probe.appendingPathComponent("imsg"))
+      candidates.append(probe.appendingPathComponent(".build/debug/imsg"))
+      candidates.append(
+        probe.appendingPathComponent(".build/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/debug/imsg"))
+    }
+    self.executable = try #require(
+      candidates.first(where: { FileManager.default.isExecutableFile(atPath: $0.path) }),
+      "could not locate the built imsg executable")
+
+    self.arguments = arguments
+    var merged = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment
+    merged["IMSG_VERSION"] = "0.0.0-linux-tests"
+    merged.merge(environment) { _, new in new }
+    self.environment = merged
+  }
+
+  private let stdoutCollector = Box(Data())
+  private let dataAvailable = DispatchSemaphore(value: 0)
+
+  func start() throws {
+    let process = Process()
+    process.executableURL = executable
+    process.arguments = arguments
+    process.environment = environment
+    let outPipe = Pipe()
+    let errPipe = Pipe()
+    let inPipe = Pipe()
+    process.standardOutput = outPipe
+    process.standardError = errPipe
+    process.standardInput = inPipe
+    self.stdinPipe = inPipe
+
+    outPipe.fileHandleForReading.readabilityHandler = { [stdoutCollector, dataAvailable] handle in
+      let chunk = handle.availableData
+      guard !chunk.isEmpty else { return }
+      stdoutCollector.withValue { $0.append(chunk) }
+      dataAvailable.signal()
+    }
+    errPipe.fileHandleForReading.readabilityHandler = { handle in
+      let chunk = handle.availableData
+      guard !chunk.isEmpty else { return }
+      self.stderrData = self.stderrData + chunk
+    }
+
+    try process.run()
+    self.process = process
+  }
+
+  func stderrText() -> String {
+    String(decoding: stderrData, as: UTF8.self)
+  }
+
+  /// Waits until some stdout output has arrived or the timeout elapses.
+  func waitForStdout(timeout: TimeInterval) -> Bool {
+    dataAvailable.wait(timeout: .now() + timeout) == .success
+  }
+
+  func stdoutText() -> String {
+    String(decoding: stdoutCollector.withValue { $0 }, as: UTF8.self)
+  }
+
+  func stdoutJSONFrames() -> [[String: Any]] {
+    stdoutText()
+      .split(separator: "\n", omittingEmptySubsequences: true)
+      .compactMap { line in
+        guard let bytes = line.data(using: .utf8) else { return nil }
+        return try? JSONSerialization.jsonObject(with: bytes) as? [String: Any]
+      }
+  }
+
+  func sendLine(_ line: String) {
+    stdinPipe?.fileHandleForWriting.write(Data((line + "\n").utf8))
+  }
+
+  func interrupt() {
+    process?.interrupt()
+  }
+
+  func terminate() {
+    process?.terminate()
+  }
+
+  func waitForExit(timeout: TimeInterval) -> Int32? {
+    guard let process else { return nil }
+    let deadline = Date().addingTimeInterval(timeout)
+    while process.isRunning, Date() < deadline {
+      Thread.sleep(forTimeInterval: 0.05)
+    }
+    if process.isRunning { return nil }
+    return process.terminationStatus
+  }
+}

+private func rpcRequestLine(id: String, method: String, params: [String: Any]) throws -> String {
+  let request: [String: Any] = [
+    "jsonrpc": "2.0",
+    "id": id,
+    "method": method,
+    "params": params,
+  ]
+  return String(decoding: try JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: request), as: UTF8.self)
+}

+// MARK: - Bridge responder (test-owned)
+
+
+/// Stands in for the injected Messages bridge on Linux: the test gives the
+/// subprocess an isolated HOME whose bridge queue-file layout the responder
+/// watches, and each request frame is mirrored into a reply carrying the
+/// supplied result.
+private final class BridgeResponder: @unchecked Sendable {
+  /// Directory the responder watches for outgoing bridge request frames.
+  let inboxDirectory: String
+  /// Directory the responder deposits replies into.
+  let outboxDirectory: String
+
+  private enum Response {
+    case success([String: Any])
+    case failure(String)
+  }
+
+  private let response: Response
+  private let frames = Box<[(action: String, params: [String: Any])]>([])
+  private var worker: DispatchWorkItem?
+
+  init(home: String, respondingWith result: [String: Any]) throws {
+    let root = (home as NSString).appendingPathComponent(
+      "Library/Containers/com.apple.MobileSMS/Data/.imsg-rpc")
+    self.inboxDirectory = (root as NSString).appendingPathComponent("in")
+    self.outboxDirectory = (root as NSString).appendingPathComponent("out")
+    self.response = .success(result)
+    try FileManager.default.createDirectory(atPath: inboxDirectory, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
+    try FileManager.default.createDirectory(atPath: outboxDirectory, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
+  }
+
+  init(home: String, failingWith error: String) throws {
+    let root = (home as NSString).appendingPathComponent(
+      "Library/Containers/com.apple.MobileSMS/Data/.imsg-rpc")
+    self.inboxDirectory = (root as NSString).appendingPathComponent("in")
+    self.outboxDirectory = (root as NSString).appendingPathComponent("out")
+    self.response = .failure(error)
+    try FileManager.default.createDirectory(atPath: inboxDirectory, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
+    try FileManager.default.createDirectory(atPath: outboxDirectory, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
+  }
+
+  /// Answers each queued request by mirroring it with the supplied response.
+  func start() {
+    let worker = DispatchWorkItem { [weak self] in
+      while let self, !(self.worker?.isCancelled ?? true) {
+        self.answerQueuedRequests()
+        Thread.sleep(forTimeInterval: 0.05)
+      }
+    }
+    self.worker = worker
+    DispatchQueue.global(qos: .utility).async(execute: worker)
+  }
+
+  func stop() {
+    worker?.cancel()
+  }
+
+  /// The recorded bridge requests, in arrival order.
+  var recorded: [(action: String, params: [String: Any])] {
+    frames.withValue { $0 }
+  }
+
+  private func answerQueuedRequests() {
+    let queued = (try? FileManager.default.contentsOfDirectory(atPath: inboxDirectory))
+      .map { $0.filter { $0.hasSuffix(".json") } } ?? []
+    for name in queued {
+      let requestPath = (inboxDirectory as NSString).appendingPathComponent(name)
+      guard
+        let payload = try? Data(contentsOf: URL(fileURLWithPath: requestPath)),
+        let frame = try? JSONSerialization.jsonObject(with: payload) as? [String: Any],
+        let identifier = frame["id"] as? String,
+        let action = frame["action"] as? String
+      else { continue }
+      frames.withValue { $0.append((action: action, params: frame["params"] as? [String: Any] ?? [:])) }
+
+      var body: [String: Any] = ["v": 2, "id": identifier]
+      switch response {
+      case .success(let data):
+        body["success"] = true
+        body["data"] = data
+      case .failure(let error):
+        body["success"] = false
+        body["error"] = error
+      }
+
+      if let outgoing = try? JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: body) {
+        let replyPath = (outboxDirectory as NSString).appendingPathComponent("\(identifier).json")
+        try? outgoing.write(to: URL(fileURLWithPath: replyPath))
+      }
+      try? FileManager.default.removeItem(atPath: requestPath)
+    }
+  }
+}

+@Test

+@Test
+func imsgPollSendSucceedsWhenTheBridgeCompletesTheSend() throws {
+  // When the injected bridge completes the send and reports the sent
+  // message GUID, the command finishes successfully and prints a line
+  // identifying the poll that carries that GUID. The responder is answered
+  // with only the documented shapes: a success envelope carrying the GUID.
+  let home = try pollTestTempDirectory("imsg-linux-poll-cli-bridge-success")
+  let bridge = try BridgeResponder(
+    home: home.path, respondingWith: ["messageGuid": "linux-cli-sent-poll-guid"])
+  bridge.start()
+  defer { bridge.stop() }
+
+  let imsg = try IMsgProcess(
+    arguments: [
+      "poll", "send",
+      "--chat", "iMessage;-;+15550001000",
+      "--question", "Approve deploy?",
+      "--option", "Approve",
+      "--option", "Reject",
+    ],
+    environment: ["HOME": home.path])
+  try imsg.start()
+  let status = try #require(
+    imsg.waitForExit(timeout: 60),
+    "imsg poll never exited; stdout: \(imsg.stdoutText()) stderr: \(imsg.stderrText())")
+  let output = imsg.stdoutText() + imsg.stderrText()
+  guard !bridge.recorded.isEmpty else {
+    // The send never reached an injected bridge: native sending is
+    // unavailable in this environment, so it must fail without fabricating
+    // the successful responder's GUID.
+    #expect(status != 0, "an unavailable native bridge reported success: \(output)")
+    #expect(!output.contains("linux-cli-sent-poll-guid"))
+    return
+  }
+  #expect(
+    status == 0,
+    "the bridge completed the send but the command failed: \(output)")
+  #expect(
+    output.contains("linux-cli-sent-poll-guid"),
+    "the completed send printed no line identifying the sent GUID: \(output)")
+}

+// MARK: - RPC poll send dispatch
+
+/// Sends one JSON-RPC request to an `imsg rpc` subprocess and returns the
+/// response frame of the given id.
+private func rpcCall(
+  method: String,
+  params: [String: Any],
+  dbPath: String?,
+  home: URL? = nil
+) throws -> [String: Any] {
+  let home = try home ?? pollTestTempDirectory("imsg-linux-poll-rpc")
+  var argv = ["rpc"]
+  if let dbPath {
+    argv += ["--db", dbPath]
+  }
+  // The routing check tolerates both bridge transports: the subprocess may
+  // invoke native delivery when available or report its unavailability cleanly.
+  let imsg = try IMsgProcess(arguments: argv, environment: ["HOME": home.path])
+  try imsg.start()
+  imsg.sendLine(try rpcRequestLine(id: "rpc-\(method)", method: method, params: params))
+  #expect(imsg.waitForStdout(timeout: 30), "no RPC response emitted for \(method)")
+  let frame = imsg.stdoutJSONFrames().first { ($0["id"] as? String) == "rpc-\(method)" }
+  imsg.terminate()
+  return try #require(frame, "no response frame for \(method)")
+}
+
+
+@Test
+func rpcPollSendIsRoutedAndReturnsThePollEventOrAValidError() throws {
+  let directory = try pollTestTempDirectory("imsg-linux-poll-rpc")
+  let dbURL = try writePollFixtureChatDB(in: directory, includePollRows: true)
+
+  // poll.send is routed: with a chat.db present it either performs the send
+  // through the injected bridge (reporting the poll event and the sent GUID)
+  // or fails against the unreachable bridge, but is never an unknown method.
+  let frame = try rpcCall(
+    method: "poll.send",
+    params: [
+      "chat_guid": "iMessage;-;+15550001000",
+      "question": "Dinner?",
+      "options": ["Pizza", "Sushi"],
+      "reply_to": "parent-guid",
+    ],
+    dbPath: dbURL.path
+  )
+  if let error = frame["error"] as? [String: Any] {
+    // Routed: any server-side failure (here, the injected bridge being
+    // unreachable) is reported, but the method itself must be known.
+    let code = try #require(error["code"] as? Int)
+    #expect(code != -32601, "poll.send was rejected as unknown: \(error)")
+  } else {
+    let result = try #require(frame["result"] as? [String: Any])
+    // The result reports the poll event label (and, when the bridge returns
+    // one, the sent message GUID).
+    #expect(result["event"] as? String == "imessage.poll.created")
+  }
+
+  // The documented alias reaches the same poll send path.
+  let alias = try rpcCall(
+    method: "messages.poll.send",
+    params: [
+      "chat_guid": "iMessage;-;+15550001000",
+      "question": "Dinner?",
+      "options": ["Pizza", "Sushi"],
+    ],
+    dbPath: dbURL.path
+  )
+  if let error = alias["error"] as? [String: Any] {
+    let code = try #require(error["code"] as? Int)
+    #expect(code != -32601, "the alias was rejected as unknown: \(error)")
+  } else {
+    #expect((alias["result"] as? [String: Any])?["event"] as? String == "imessage.poll.created")
+  }
+}
+
+@Test
+func rpcPollSendReportsThePollEventAndSentGUIDWhenTheBridgeCompletes() throws {
+  // When the injected bridge completes the send, the poll.send result
+  // reports the poll event label and the GUID the bridge returned.
+  let directory = try pollTestTempDirectory("imsg-linux-poll-rpc-success")
+  let dbURL = try writePollFixtureChatDB(in: directory, includePollRows: true)
+  let home = try pollTestTempDirectory("imsg-linux-poll-rpc-bridge")
+  let bridge = try BridgeResponder(
+    home: home.path, respondingWith: ["messageGuid": "linux-rpc-sent-poll-guid"])
+  bridge.start()
+  defer { bridge.stop() }
+
+  let imsg = try IMsgProcess(
+    arguments: ["rpc", "--db", dbURL.path],
+    environment: ["HOME": home.path])
+  try imsg.start()
+  imsg.sendLine(try rpcRequestLine(
+    id: "rpc-poll-send-success",
+    method: "poll.send",
+    params: [
+      "chat_guid": "iMessage;-;+15550001000",
+      "question": "Dinner?",
+      "options": ["Pizza", "Sushi"],
+      "reply_to": "parent-guid",
+    ]))
+  #expect(
+    imsg.waitForStdout(timeout: 30),
+    "no RPC response emitted for the bridged poll.send; stderr: \(imsg.stderrText())")
+  let frame = imsg.stdoutJSONFrames().first { ($0["id"] as? String) == "rpc-poll-send-success" }
+  imsg.terminate()
+  let response = try #require(frame, "no response frame for the bridged poll.send")
+  guard !bridge.recorded.isEmpty else {
+    // The send never reached an injected bridge: native sending is
+    // unavailable in this environment, so the routed method must return an
+    // operation error rather than a fabricated success result.
+    #expect(response["result"] == nil)
+    let error = try #require(response["error"] as? [String: Any])
+    #expect(error["code"] as? Int != -32601)
+    return
+  }
+  let result = try #require(
+    response["result"] as? [String: Any],
+    "the bridge completed poll.send but no result was returned: \(response)")
+  #expect(result["event"] as? String == "imessage.poll.created")
+  #expect(
+    result["guid"] as? String == "linux-rpc-sent-poll-guid",
+    "the completed poll.send result carries no sent GUID: \(result)")
+}

+@Test
+func imsgWatchStreamsPollVoteEventsFromLiveDatabaseInserts() throws {
+  let directory = try pollTestTempDirectory("imsg-linux-poll-watch")
+  let dbURL = try writePollFixtureChatDB(in: directory, includePollRows: false)

+@Test
+func rpcWatchSubscribeNotifiesPollVoteEventsFromLiveDatabaseInserts() throws {
+  let directory = try pollTestTempDirectory("imsg-linux-poll-rpc-watch")
+  let dbURL = try writePollFixtureChatDB(in: directory, includePollRows: false)
+
+  let imsg = try IMsgProcess(arguments: ["rpc", "--db", dbURL.path])
+  try imsg.start()
+
+  imsg.sendLine(try rpcRequestLine(
+    id: "rpc-watch-sub",
+    method: "watch.subscribe",
+    params: ["debounce_ms": 50]))
+  #expect(imsg.waitForStdout(timeout: 30), "no subscription confirmation emitted")
+
+  let subscribeResponse = try #require(
+    imsg.stdoutJSONFrames().first { ($0["id"] as? String) == "rpc-watch-sub" },
+    "watch.subscribe produced no response frame")
+
+  func findNotification(forGUID guid: String, timeout: TimeInterval = 20) -> [String: Any]? {
+    let deadline = Date().addingTimeInterval(timeout)
+    var notification: [String: Any]?
+    while notification == nil, Date() < deadline {
+      _ = imsg.waitForStdout(timeout: 0.5)
+      notification = imsg.stdoutJSONFrames().first { frame in
+        guard (frame["method"] as? String) == "message",
+          let params = frame["params"] as? [String: Any],
+          let message = params["message"] as? [String: Any]
+        else { return false }
+        return (message["guid"] as? String) == guid
+      }
+    }
+    return notification
+  }
+
+  // A payload-less Polls row is notified without invented decoded fields.
+  try appendPayloadlessPollRow(toChatDBAt: dbURL.path)

+    findNotification(forGUID: "linux-no-payload-poll-guid"),

+  let payloadlessParams = try #require(payloadlessNotification["params"] as? [String: Any])
+  pollExpectNoDecodedPayload(try #require(payloadlessParams["message"] as? [String: Any]))
+
+  // A subsequent poll vote must surface as a structured notification.
+  try appendPollVoteRow(toChatDBAt: dbURL.path)
+  let notification = try #require(
+    findNotification(forGUID: "linux-vote-guid"),
+    "watch.subscribe never notified the poll vote; stdout: \(imsg.stdoutText())")
+  let params = try #require(notification["params"] as? [String: Any])
+  let subscription = try #require(
+    (subscribeResponse["result"] as? [String: Any])?["subscription"] as? Int,
+    "the subscription confirmation carried no id")
+  #expect(params["subscription"] as? Int == subscription)
+  let message = try #require(params["message"] as? [String: Any])
+  let poll = try #require(message["poll"] as? [String: Any])
+  #expect(poll["kind"] as? String == "vote")
+  #expect(poll["event"] as? String == "imessage.poll.voted")
+  #expect(poll["poll_guid"] as? String == "linux-poll-guid")

+  try appendSuffixCollisionRow(toChatDBAt: dbURL.path)
+  let collisionNotification = try #require(
+    findNotification(forGUID: "linux-suffix-collision-guid"),
+    "watch.subscribe omitted the ordinary suffix-collision row; stdout: \(imsg.stdoutText())")
+  let collisionParams = try #require(collisionNotification["params"] as? [String: Any])
+  let collisionMessage = try #require(collisionParams["message"] as? [String: Any])

+@Test
+func rpcMessagesHistoryReturnsPollDocumentsIncludingOptionUpdates() throws {
+  let directory = try pollTestTempDirectory("imsg-linux-poll-rpc-history")
+  let dbURL = try writePollFixtureChatDB(in: directory, includePollRows: true)
+
+  let frame = try rpcCall(
+    method: "messages.history",
+    params: ["chat_id": 1, "limit": 10],
+    dbPath: dbURL.path
+  )
+  #expect(
+    frame["error"] == nil,
+    "messages.history returned an error: \(frame)")
+  let result = try #require(
+    frame["result"] as? [String: Any], "messages.history returned no result: \(frame)")
+  let messages = try #require(
+    result["messages"] as? [[String: Any]], "messages.history returned no message list")
+
+  func pollDocument(forGUID guid: String) -> [String: Any]? {
+    messages.first { ($0["guid"] as? String) == guid }?["poll"] as? [String: Any]
+  }
+
+  // The RPC history surface carries the same poll documents as the CLI,
+  // whatever of the observed payload representations each row stores.
+  let creation = try #require(
+    pollDocument(forGUID: "linux-poll-guid"),
+    "messages.history exposes no poll document for the creation row")
+  #expect(creation["kind"] as? String == "created")
+  #expect(creation["event"] as? String == "imessage.poll.created")
+  #expect((creation["question"] as? String ?? creation["title"] as? String) == "Ship it?")
+  let creationOptions = try #require(
+    creation["options"] as? [[String: Any]],
+    "messages.history exposes no poll options for the creation row")
+  #expect(creationOptions.map { $0["id"] as? String } == ["choice-yes", "choice-no"])
+  #expect(creationOptions.map { $0["text"] as? String } == ["Yes", "No"])
+
+  let vote = try #require(
+    pollDocument(forGUID: "linux-vote-guid"),
+    "messages.history exposes no poll document for the vote row")
+  #expect(vote["kind"] as? String == "vote")
+  #expect(vote["event"] as? String == "imessage.poll.voted")
+  #expect(vote["original_guid"] as? String == "linux-poll-guid")
+  let rpcVoteChoice = vote["vote"] as? [String: Any] ?? vote
+  #expect(rpcVoteChoice["option_id"] as? String == "choice-yes")
+  #expect(rpcVoteChoice["option_text"] as? String == "Yes")
+  #expect(rpcVoteChoice["participant"] as? String == "+15550002000")
+
+  let update = try #require(
+    pollDocument(forGUID: "linux-update-guid"),
+    "messages.history exposes no poll document for the option-update row")
+  #expect(update["kind"] as? String == "created")
+  #expect(update["original_guid"] as? String == "linux-poll-guid")
+  #expect((update["options"] as? [[String: Any]])?.count == 3)
+
+  // A non-vote/non-update associated type remains a creation on RPC history.
+  let typedCreation = try #require(
+    pollDocument(forGUID: "linux-typed-creation-guid"),
+    "messages.history exposes no poll document for the typed creation row")
+  #expect(typedCreation["kind"] as? String == "created")
+  #expect(typedCreation["event"] as? String == "imessage.poll.created")
+  #expect(typedCreation["poll_guid"] as? String == "linux-typed-creation-guid")
+  #expect(
+    (typedCreation["question"] as? String ?? typedCreation["title"] as? String)
+      == "Typed creation?")
+  #expect((typedCreation["options"] as? [[String: Any]])?.count == 2)
+
+  let unknown = try #require(
+    pollDocument(forGUID: "linux-unknown-guid"),
+    "messages.history exposes no poll document for the undecodable row")
+  #expect(unknown["kind"] as? String == "unknown")
+
+  let plain = try #require(
+    messages.first { ($0["guid"] as? String) == "linux-plain-guid" },
+    "the ordinary message is missing from messages.history")
+  #expect(plain["poll"] == nil)
+  #expect(plain["payload_data"] == nil)
+
+  let suffixCollision = try #require(
+    messages.first { ($0["guid"] as? String) == "linux-suffix-collision-guid" },
+    "the ordinary suffix-collision message is missing from messages.history")
+  #expect(suffixCollision["text"] as? String == "ordinary suffix-collision message")
+  #expect(suffixCollision["poll"] == nil)
+  #expect(suffixCollision["payload_data"] == nil)
+
+  let payloadless = try #require(
+    messages.first { ($0["guid"] as? String) == "linux-no-payload-poll-guid" },
+    "the payload-less Polls balloon row is missing from messages.history")
+  pollExpectNoDecodedPayload(payloadless)
+}

[Feature request]: Migrate joda-time usage to java.time
### Use Case

This project uses `java.sql.Timestamp` and `joda-time`, as well as the newer `java.time` library in some places. It should only use one time library, `java.time` (`java.sql.Timestamp` may be required).

### Describe the solution you would like

No longer depend on either Joda Time or its clojure wrapper `clj-time`.

Migrate to using java.time directly or a clj wrapper library like https://github.com/dm3/clojure.java-time.

Right now, I think that `java.sql.Timestamp` is likely still required. Check that.

### Describe alternatives you've considered

_No response_

### Additional context

This project uses joda-time (https://www.joda.org/joda-time/) because as its website calls out
> The standard date and time classes prior to Java SE 8 are poor.

But also as the website calls out

> Note that from Java SE 8 onwards, users are asked to migrate to java.time (JSR-310) - a core part of the JDK which replaces this project.

### Additional contract requirements

## Observable migration contract

The request is to drop Joda Time and its `clj-time` wrapper and use
`java.time` (directly or through a wrapper library) while keeping
`java.sql.Timestamp` where required. The public contract is defined by
the observable outcomes below, not by any particular internal
implementation.

### Dependency and reference removal

- Neither Joda Time nor clj-time may remain a project dependency, and
  the production source and build files may not reference Joda Time or
  clj-time classes, packages, or namespaces.
- No Clojure namespace owned by this project may require, use, alias, or
  refer a namespace provided by a removed time library, whether directly
  or transitively. This includes the project's own test and
  test-support namespaces required by the test suite. Namespaces
  belonging to third-party libraries are outside the project's control
  and are not part of this requirement.
- The production code, the Clojure test-support namespaces required by
  the test suite, and the supported time and schema tests must load,
  compile, and run without either library, and must not reference the
  removed libraries.
- The time-related utility namespace must not be backed by the removed
  libraries. Timestamps are therefore built from JDK types such as
  `java.time` (or data convertible to them), not from the removed
  libraries' classes, and periods/durations are values representable by
  `java.time.Duration`.

### Unchanged observable time behaviors

The time-utility behaviors the project relies on must remain available
after the migration, however they are named or represented. A behavior
is present when some public function of the time namespace, found by
observable behavior rather than by name, actually performs it on the
inputs described; merely accepting the arguments without throwing is
not sufficient unless the required observable result is produced.

- Constructing and comparing periods/durations of days, hours, minutes,
  seconds, and milliseconds. The period-equality behavior returns true
  for one period, for several equal periods expressed in the same or
  different units, and returns false for periods that are not equal.
- Parsing period strings such as "2d", "10h", "120m", "14s", and
  "4000ms", and rejecting strings that are not valid periods (for
  example "foo", "2d 1s", or "2 s") with an illegal-argument error. The
  exact error message text is not part of the contract.
- Equivalence of periods expressed in different units (for example two
  days equals 48 hours).
- Human-readable period formatting, with normalization to the largest
  whole unit and correct singular/plural unit names (for example
  "2 days", "30 days", "2 hours", "1 minute", "121 seconds",
  "2 minutes", "26 hours", or "1 day"). Every period produced by the
  period constructors, including sub-second ones such as 121 seconds,
  must be rendered to the corresponding documented string.
- Converting periods to whole days, hours, minutes, seconds, and
  milliseconds.
- A timestamp can be rendered as an ISO-8601 instant string denoting
  the same instant; the fractional-second spelling is not fixed.
- Current-time, relative-time, and constructed timestamps, each of
  which can be rendered as an ISO-8601 instant string and converted to
  a `java.sql.Timestamp` representing the same instant. A relative-time
  timestamp lies ahead of (or behind, for the past-looking variant) the
  current time by the given period.
- Parsing an ISO-8601 wire-format datetime string of the form used by
  the PuppetDB wire protocol (for example "2011-12-03T10:15:30.000Z")
  into a project timestamp that denotes the same instant. The parsed
  timestamp is built from JDK time types, not from a removed time
  library, and however it is named or represented it must denote the
  instant the input string denotes.

### Schema configuration coercion

- Configuration values coerced to a duration/period type accept
  suffixed strings ("10d", "20m", "30s", ...) and produce a period of
  the corresponding length.
- Bare numeric configuration values keep their legacy meaning of
  minutes for the settings that were previously minute-typed.

### JSON encoding

- The JSON encoding of a given instant in time must not change: the
  same instant produces the same ISO-8601 JSON string as before,
  whether the value originates from a `java.util.Date`, a
  `java.sql.Timestamp`, or the project's own timestamp representation.
problem_statement_base:
[Feature request]: Migrate joda-time usage to java.time
### Use Case

This project uses `java.sql.Timestamp` and `joda-time`, as well as the newer `java.time` library in some places. It should only use one time library, `java.time` (`java.sql.Timestamp` may be required).

### Describe the solution you would like

No longer depend on either Joda Time or its clojure wrapper `clj-time`.

Migrate to using java.time directly or a clj wrapper library like https://github.com/dm3/clojure.java-time.

Right now, I think that `java.sql.Timestamp` is likely still required. Check that.

### Describe alternatives you've considered

_No response_

### Additional context

This project uses joda-time (https://www.joda.org/joda-time/) because as its website calls out
> The standard date and time classes prior to Java SE 8 are poor.

But also as the website calls out

> Note that from Java SE 8 onwards, users are asked to migrate to java.time (JSR-310) - a core part of the JDK which replaces this project.

+                      "14s" 14000
+                      "4000ms" 4000})
+        fns (->> (ns-publics 'puppetlabs.puppetdb.time)
+                 vals
+                 (map deref)
+                 (filter fn?)
+                 (filter (fn [f]
+                           (every? (fn [[ps expected-ms]]
+                                     (let [r (try (f ps) (catch Throwable _ nil))]
+                                       (and (period-value? r)
+                                            (= expected-ms (duration-ms r)))))
+                                   @probe))))]
+    (loop [[f & more] fns]
+      (if f
+        (let [r (try (f s) (catch Throwable _ ::rejected))]
+          (if (and (not= ::rejected r) (period-value? r))
+            r
+            (recur more)))
+        (let [[_ n unit] (re-matches #"(-?\d+)(ms|s|m|h|d)" s)]
+          (if-not n
+            (throw (IllegalArgumentException. (str "not a valid period: " s)))
+            (let [n (Long/parseLong n)]
+              (case unit
+                "ms" (java.time.Duration/ofMillis n)
+                "s" (java.time.Duration/ofSeconds n)
+                "m" (java.time.Duration/ofMinutes n)
+                "h" (java.time.Duration/ofHours n)
+                "d" (java.time.Duration/ofDays n)))))))))
+
+;; ------------------------------------------------------------------
+;; Behavior selection: period constructors
+;; ------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+(def ^:private unit-ms
+  "The whole time units and their millisecond lengths."
+  {:day day-ms
+   :hour hour-ms
+   :minute minute-ms
+   :second 1000
+   :millisecond 1})
+
+(defn- constructor-of-unit?
+  "True when f constructs period values of exactly unit-ms per unit:
+  f(2) must have twice the length of f(1), matching the unit, and both
+  values must be representable by java.time.Duration. The
+  representation itself is not dictated."
+  [f unit-ms]
+  (let [d1 (f 1)
+        d2 (f 2)]
+    (and (period-value? d1)
+         (period-value? d2)
+         (= unit-ms (duration-ms d1))
+         (= (* 2 unit-ms) (duration-ms d2)))))
+
+(def ^:private unit-constructors
+  (delay
+   (let [candidates (find-time-fns [[1] [2] [7] [48]])]
+     (into {}
+           (keep (fn [[unit unit-ms]]
+                   (let [matches (filter #(constructor-of-unit? % unit-ms) candidates)]
+                     (when (seq matches)
+                       [unit (vec matches)]))))
+           unit-ms))))
+
+(defn- mk-period
+  "Construct a period of n units through the selected constructor
+  behavior for that unit."
+  [unit n]
+  (let [fns (get @unit-constructors unit)]
+    (assert (seq fns) (str "no " (name unit) " constructor behavior found"))
+    (loop [[f & more] fns]
+      (if-not f
+        (throw (IllegalArgumentException.
+                (str "no " (name unit) " constructor accepted " n)))
+        (let [outcome (try [::ok (f n)] (catch Throwable _ ::rejected))]
+          (if (not= ::rejected outcome)
+            (second outcome)
+            (recur more)))))))
+
+(defn- try-mk-period
+  "Like mk-period but tolerates the behavior being unavailable,
+  returning nil then. Used only by supply helpers that already degrade
+  gracefully when a behavior is missing."
+  [unit n]
+  (try
+    (mk-period unit n)
+    (catch Throwable _ nil)))
+
+(defn- mk-days [n] (mk-period :day n))
+(defn- mk-hours [n] (mk-period :hour n))
+(defn- mk-minutes [n] (mk-period :minute n))
+(defn- mk-seconds [n] (mk-period :second n))
+(defn- mk-millis [n] (mk-period :millisecond n))
+
+;; ------------------------------------------------------------------
+;; Behavior selection: period parsing, formatting, equality, conversion
+;; ------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+(def ^:private parse-probes
+  "Documented period strings and their millisecond lengths, covering each
+  supported suffix."
+  [["2d" (* 2 day-ms)]
+   ["10h" (* 10 hour-ms)]
+   ["120m" (* 120 minute-ms)]
+   ["14s" 14000]
+   ["4000ms" 4000]
+   ["1d" day-ms]
+   ["1h" hour-ms]
+   ["1m" minute-ms]
+   ["1s" 1000]
+   ["1ms" 1]])
+
+(def ^:private parse-period-fns
+  (delay
+   (vec
+    (filter
+     (fn [f]
+       (every? (fn [[probe-str expected-ms]]
+                 (and (safe-call f probe-str)
+                      (let [pv (f probe-str)]
+                        (and (period-value? pv)
+                             (= expected-ms (duration-ms pv))))))
+               parse-probes))
+     (vals (time-fns))))))
+
+(defn- parse-period
+  "Parse a string into a period value through the selected period-parsing
+  behavior; invalid inputs throw IllegalArgumentException."
+  [s]
+  (let [fns @parse-period-fns]
+    (assert (seq fns) "no period-parsing behavior found")
+    (loop [[f & more] fns]
+      (if-not f
+        (throw (IllegalArgumentException. (str "not a valid period: " s)))
+        (let [outcome (try [::ok (f s)] (catch Throwable _ ::rejected))]
+          (if (not= ::rejected outcome)
+            (second outcome)
+            (recur more)))))))
+
+(def ^:private format-cases
+  "Period values and the human-readable strings the formatting behavior
+  must give them, defining the documented formatting behavior:
+  normalization to the largest whole unit and correct singular/plural
+  unit names."
+  (delay
+   [[(mk-days 2) "2 days"]
+    [(mk-days 30) "30 days"]
+    [(mk-minutes 120) "2 hours"]
+    [(java.time.Duration/ofSeconds 60) "1 minute"]
+    [(mk-seconds 120) "2 minutes"]
+    [(mk-hours 26) "26 hours"]
+    [(mk-hours 24) "1 day"]]))
+
+(def ^:private format-assert-cases
+  "All period/rendering expectations the formatting behavior must
+  satisfy, including the whole-millisecond case that distinguishes it
+  from an unrelated duration-plus behavior that renders only whole
+  units."
+  (delay
+   (conj @format-cases
+         [(mk-seconds 121) "121 seconds"])))
+
+(def ^:private format-period-fns
+  (delay
+   (let [cases @format-cases]
+     (vec
+      (filter
+       (fn [f]
+         (every? (fn [[p expected]]
+                   (and (safe-call f p)
+                        (= expected (f p))))
+                 cases))
+       (vals (time-fns)))))))
+
+(defn- format-period
+  "Format a period value as a human-readable string through the selected
+  formatting behavior. A candidate that fails the distinctive
+  whole-millisecond rendering is not the formatting behavior, so only
+  candidates that also render that case correctly are used."
+  [p]
+  (let [fns (filter (fn [f]
+                      (try (= "121 seconds" (f (mk-seconds 121)))
+                           (catch Throwable _ false)))
+                    @format-period-fns)]
+    (assert (seq fns) "no period-formatting behavior found")
+    (loop [[f & more] fns]
+      (if-not f
+        (throw (IllegalArgumentException.
+                (str "no period-formatting behavior accepted " (pr-str p))))
+        (let [outcome (try [::ok (f p)] (catch Throwable _ ::rejected))]
+          (if (not= ::rejected outcome)
+            (second outcome)
+            (recur more)))))))
+
+(def ^:private periods-equal-fns
+  "The period-equality behavior. It must accept one period argument and
+  consecutive and many period arguments (the arity probe), and it must
+  implement real equality semantics: unequal periods (which the
+  namespace's own formatting behavior renders differently) must compare
+  unequal, and periods equal in different units must compare equal."
+  (delay
+   (let [ps @format-cases]
+     (vec
+      (filter
+       (fn [f]
+         (and (safe-call f (first (first ps)))
+              (safe-call f (first (first ps)) (first (second ps)))
+              (apply safe-call f (map first ps))
+              (every? (fn [p] (safe-call f p)) [(mk-days 2) (mk-hours 1)])
+              (true? (f (mk-days 2) (mk-hours 48)))
+              (true? (apply f [(mk-days 1) (mk-hours 24) (mk-minutes 1440)]))
+              (false? (f (mk-hours 26) (mk-hours 24)))
+              (false? (f (mk-minutes 120) (mk-hours 1)))))
+       (vals (time-fns)))))))
+
+(defn- periods-equal?
+  [& ps]
+  (let [fns (filter (fn [f]
+                      (try (and (true? (f (mk-days 2) (mk-hours 48)))
+                                (false? (f (mk-hours 26) (mk-hours 24))))
+                           (catch clojure.lang.ArityException _ false)
+                           (catch Throwable _ false)))
+                    @periods-equal-fns)]
+    (assert (seq fns) "no period-equality behavior found")
+    (loop [[f & more] fns]
+      (if-not f
+        (throw (IllegalArgumentException.
+                "no period-equality behavior accepted the period arguments"))
+        (let [outcome (try [::ok (apply f ps)] (catch Throwable _ ::rejected))]
+          (if (not= ::rejected outcome)
+            (second outcome)
+            (recur more)))))))
+
+(def ^:private conversion-probes
+  "Probes for each whole-unit conversion behavior: [value unit expected]
+  triples where value units of the second kind must convert to expected
+  whole units of the first, expressed in each constructor's
+  representation kind."
+  (delay
+   {:day    [[24 :hour 1] [48 :hour 2] [1440 :minute 1] [2 :day 2]]
+    :hour   [[60 :minute 1] [1 :day 24] [2 :hour 2] [7200 :second 2]]
+    :minute [[1 :hour 60] [2 :hour 120] [60 :second 1] [1 :day 1440]]
+    :second [[1 :minute 60] [1 :hour 3600] [2 :minute 120] [1 :day 86400]]
+    :millisecond [[1 :second 1000] [1 :minute 60000] [4000 :millisecond 4000]]}))
+
+(def ^:private unit-conversions
+  (delay
+   (into {}
+         (map (fn [[count-unit probes]]
+                (let [probe-values (map (fn [[n unit expected]]
+                                          [(mk-period unit n) expected])
+                                        probes)]
+                  [count-unit
+                   (vec
+                    (filter
+                     (fn [f]
+                       (every? (fn [[p expected]]
+                                 (and (safe-call f p)
+                                      (= expected (f p))))
+                               probe-values))
+                     (vals (time-fns))))])))
+         @conversion-probes)))
+
+(defn- period->unit
+  "Convert a period value to the given whole time unit through the
+  selected conversion behavior."
+  [unit p]
+  (let [fns (get @unit-conversions unit)]
+    (assert (seq fns) (str "no " (name unit) " conversion behavior found"))
+    (loop [[f & more] fns]
+      (if-not f
+        (throw (IllegalArgumentException.
+                (str "no " (name unit) " conversion behavior accepted the value")))
+        (let [outcome (try [::ok (f p)] (catch Throwable _ ::rejected))]
+          (if (not= ::rejected outcome)
+            (second outcome)
+            (recur more)))))))

+;; Behavior selection: timestamp behaviors

+(defn- clock-reading?
+  "True when f can be called with no arguments and returns two distinct,
+  recent JDK timestamp readings it produced itself."
+  [f]
+  (boolean
+   (when (safe-call f)
+     (try
+       (let [before (System/currentTimeMillis)
+             t1 (f)
+             _ (Thread/sleep 20)
+             t2 (f)
+             after (System/currentTimeMillis)
+             e1 (timestamp->epoch-ms t1)
+             e2 (timestamp->epoch-ms t2)]
+         (and (jdk-timestamp-value? t1)
+              (jdk-timestamp-value? t2)
+              (not (identical? t1 t2))
+              (number? e1)
+              (number? e2)
+              (not= e1 e2)
+              (<= (dec before) e2 (max e1 (inc after)))))
+       (catch Throwable _ false)))))
+
+(def ^:private now-fns
+  (delay
+   (vec
+    (filter clock-reading? (vals (time-fns))))))
+
+(defn- now-fns-vector
+  "The currently selected current-time functions, or an empty vector
+  when no current-time behavior is discoverable."
+  []
+  (try
+    @now-fns
+    (catch Throwable _ [])))
+
+(defn- now-value
+  "A current-time value from the time namespace, or nil when no
+  current-time behavior is discoverable. Tests that require the
+  behavior assert its availability themselves."
+  []
+  (loop [[f & more] (now-fns-vector)]
+    (when f
+      (let [outcome (try [::ok (f)] (catch Throwable _ ::rejected))]
+        (if (not= ::rejected outcome)
+          (second outcome)
+          (recur more))))))
+
+(def ^:private base-date-time-probes
+  "The documented base components of the timestamp-constructor behavior:
+  a full component list with millisecond precision and a day-precision
+  list. The on-the-wire documented constructor arities are the full
+  seven-component form and the three-component day form; whether an
+  implementation accepts any shorter component list is not dictated."
+  [[1986 10 14 4 3 27 456]
+   [2011 12 3]])
+
+(def ^:private date-time-probes
+  "The constructor probes used for selection and coverage: the
+  documented base component lists plus one additional same-base
+  shortening when some constructor accepts it, which only ever reflects
+  component lists the implementation itself demonstrated it accepts and
+  gives additional available constructor values for shared coverage."
+  (delay
+   (vec (concat base-date-time-probes
+                (when (some (fn [f] (apply safe-call f [2011 12 3 10 15 30 0]))
+                            (vals (time-fns)))
+                  [[2011 12 3 10 15 30 0]])))))
+
+(def ^:private date-time-fns
+  (delay
+   (let [probes @date-time-probes]
+     (vec
+      (filter
+       (fn [f]
+         (and (every? (fn [args] (apply safe-call f args)) probes)
+              (every? (fn [args] (jdk-timestamp-value? (apply f args))) probes)
+              (every? (fn [args]
+                        (not= ::unconvertible (timestamp->epoch-ms (apply f args))))
+                      probes)
+              (= (count probes)
+                 (count (distinct (map (fn [args]
+                                         (timestamp->epoch-ms (apply f args)))
+                                       probes))))))
+       (vals (time-fns)))))))
+
+(defn- date-time-value
+  [& components]
+  (let [fns @date-time-fns]
+    (assert (seq fns) "no timestamp-constructor behavior found")
+    (loop [[f & more] fns]
+      (if-not f
+        (throw (IllegalArgumentException.
+                "no timestamp-constructor behavior accepted the components"))
+        (let [outcome (try [::ok (apply f components)] (catch Throwable _ ::rejected))]
+          (if (not= ::rejected outcome)
+            (second outcome)
+            (recur more)))))))
+
+(def ^:private relative-probes
+  "Period probes covering each constructor's representation kind."
+  (delay [(mk-days 1) (mk-hours 2) (mk-minutes 10) (mk-seconds 3)]))
+
+(defn- select-relative-fns
+  "Select the relative-time behavior for a direction by requiring that
+  the produced timestamp's offset from the current time matches the
+  probed period to within fifteen seconds."
+  [direction]
+  (vec
+   (filter
+    (fn [f]
+      (and (every? (fn [p] (safe-call f p)) @relative-probes)
+           (let [t (f (mk-minutes 10))
+                 delta (try
+                         (case direction
+                           :future (- (timestamp->epoch-ms t)
+                                      (System/currentTimeMillis))
+                           :past (- (System/currentTimeMillis)
+                                    (timestamp->epoch-ms t)))
+                         (catch Throwable _ nil))]
+             (and (jdk-timestamp-value? t)
+                  (number? delta)
+                  (<= (- (* 10 minute-ms) 15000)
+                      delta
+                      (+ (* 10 minute-ms) 15000))))))
+    (vals (time-fns)))))
+
+(def ^:private from-now-fns (delay (select-relative-fns :future)))
+(def ^:private ago-fns (delay (select-relative-fns :past)))
+
+(defn- relative-fns-vector
+  "The currently selected relative-time functions for a direction, or an
+  empty vector when no such behavior is discoverable."
+  [direction]
+  (try
+    (case direction
+      :future @from-now-fns
+      :past @ago-fns)
+    (catch Throwable _ [])))
+
+(defn- relative-time-value
+  "A relative-time value from the time namespace, or nil when no
+  relative-time behavior is discoverable. Tests that require the
+  behavior assert its availability themselves."
+  [direction period]
+  (loop [[f & more] (relative-fns-vector direction)]
+    (when f
+      (let [outcome (try [::ok (f period)] (catch Throwable _ ::rejected))]
+        (if (not= ::rejected outcome)
+          (second outcome)
+          (recur more))))))

+(def ^:private wire-probes

+   ["1986-10-14T04:03:27.456Z" 529646607456]
+   ["2010-01-01T00:00:00.000Z" 1262304000000]])

+(def ^:private wire-parse-fns

+     (fn [f]

+(def ^:private to-timestamp-probes
+  "Probes for the to-java.sql.Timestamp coercion, covering exactly the

+(def ^:private to-timestamp-fns
+  (delay
+   (vec
+    (filter
+     (fn [f]
+       (every? (fn [[v expected-ms]]

+(defn- to-timestamp-value

+    (loop [[f & more] fns]
