diff --git a/tests/unit/src/test/scala/tests/JavaMtagsReplaceSuite.scala b/tests/unit/src/test/scala/tests/JavaMtagsReplaceSuite.scala
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..9916739e1
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/unit/src/test/scala/tests/JavaMtagsReplaceSuite.scala
@@ -0,0 +1,620 @@
+package tests
+
+import scala.meta.inputs.Input
+import scala.meta.internal.jdk.CollectionConverters._
+import scala.meta.internal.metals.JavadocIndexer
+import scala.meta.internal.metals.JavadocParser
+import scala.meta.internal.mtags.Mtags
+import scala.meta.internal.mtags.Semanticdbs
+import scala.meta.pc.ContentType
+import scala.meta.pc.SymbolDocumentation
+import scala.meta.pc.reports.EmptyReportContext
+
+/**
+ * Black-box contract tests for Java source indexing and Java documentation
+ * indexing. These exercise only the public indexing entry points
+ * (`Mtags.allToplevels` and `JavadocIndexer.all`) and are independent of the
+ * underlying Java parser implementation.
+ */
+class JavaMtagsReplaceSuite extends BaseSuite {
+
+  implicit val rc: EmptyReportContext = new EmptyReportContext()
+
+  private def printJavaSymbols(code: String): String = {
+    val input = Input.VirtualFile("Test.java", code)
+    val doc = Mtags.allToplevels(input, scala.meta.dialects.Scala213)
+    Semanticdbs.printTextDocument(doc)
+  }
+
+  /** All SemanticDB symbols rendered as occurrences in the source, in order. */
+  private def occurrencesOf(code: String): List[String] =
+    occurrencesOfPrinted(printJavaSymbols(code))
+
+  private def occurrencesOfPrinted(printed: String): List[String] =
+    "/\\*([^*]+)\\*/".r.findAllMatchIn(printed).map(_.group(1)).toList
+
+  private def javadocDocs(
+      code: String,
+      contentType: ContentType = ContentType.MARKDOWN
+  ): Map[String, SymbolDocumentation] = {
+    val input = Input.VirtualFile("Test.java", code)
+    JavadocIndexer
+      .all(input, contentType)
+      .map(d => d.symbol() -> d)
+      .toMap
+  }
+
+  private def assertContainsOccurrence(
+      code: String,
+      symbol: String
+  ): Unit = {
+    val printed = printJavaSymbols(code)
+    val occurrences = occurrencesOfPrinted(printed)
+    assert(
+      occurrences.contains(symbol),
+      s"missing occurrence symbol <$symbol> in rendered index:\n$printed"
+    )
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Renders any stripped-comment representation (for example a `List` of
+   * lines or a single newline-joined `String`) as one body line per item,
+   * so these assertions stay independent of the concrete return type the
+   * utility chooses for `stripComment`.
+   */
+  private def renderStripped(value: Any): String =
+    value match {
+      case null => ""
+      case lines: Iterable[_] =>
+        lines.iterator.map(line => String.valueOf(line)).mkString("\n")
+      case other => String.valueOf(other)
+    }
+
+  /**
+   * Renders any parameter-tags representation as `name -> "name description"`
+   * pairs, whether the utility maps each parameter name directly to its
+   * description string or to a structured per-parameter value (for example a
+   * case class carrying the name and folded description in its first two
+   * fields).
+   */
+  private def renderParamTags(value: Any): List[(String, String)] = {
+    def normalizeEntry(entry: (String, Any)): (String, String) =
+      entry match {
+        case (name, tag: Product)
+            if tag != null && tag.productArity >= 2 &&
+              tag.productElement(1) != null =>
+          val description = String.valueOf(tag.productElement(1))
+          if (description.isEmpty) name -> name
+          else name -> s"$name $description"
+        case (name, description) =>
+          name -> String.valueOf(description)
+      }
+
+    value match {
+      case null => Nil
+      case entries: Iterable[_] =>
+        entries.iterator.toList.map {
+          case (name: String, description) => normalizeEntry(name -> description)
+          case other =>
+            val rendered = String.valueOf(other)
+            rendered -> rendered
+        }
+      case other =>
+        val rendered = String.valueOf(other)
+        List(rendered -> rendered)
+    }
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Every symbol reported for a source file: those rendered as occurrences
+   * plus the symbol table entries. A synthesized default constructor is a
+   * constructor symbol of its class even when no source occurrence is
+   * rendered for it.
+   */
+  private def indexedSymbols(code: String): Set[String] = {
+    val input = Input.VirtualFile("Test.java", code)
+    val doc = Mtags.allToplevels(input, scala.meta.dialects.Scala213)
+    occurrencesOfPrinted(Semanticdbs.printTextDocument(doc)).toSet ++
+      doc.symbols.iterator.map(_.symbol).toSet
+  }
+
+  /**
+   * Calls a public `JavadocParser` method that takes an optional raw comment.
+   * The contract states the behaviour for absent comments but not the Scala
+   * type used to pass them. The call therefore adapts to whichever input
+   * representation the utility declares: an `Option[String]` overload is
+   * preferred, a `String` overload receives the comment or an empty string
+   * when it is absent, and a wrapper type with an `Option` constructor
+   * receives the comment wrapped in that type.
+   */
+  private def callWithComment(
+      methodName: String,
+      comment: Option[String]
+  ): Any = {
+    val module: AnyRef = JavadocParser
+    val candidates = module.getClass.getMethods.toList.filter(m =>
+      m.getName == methodName && m.getParameterCount == 1
+    )
+    def parameterType(m: java.lang.reflect.Method): Class[_] =
+      m.getParameterTypes()(0)
+
+    val optionCall: Option[(java.lang.reflect.Method, AnyRef)] =
+      candidates
+        .find(parameterType(_) == classOf[Option[_]])
+        .map(m => (m, comment))
+    val stringCall: Option[(java.lang.reflect.Method, AnyRef)] =
+      candidates
+        .find(parameterType(_) == classOf[String])
+        .map(m => (m, comment.getOrElse("")))
+    val wrapperCall: Option[(java.lang.reflect.Method, AnyRef)] =
+      candidates.iterator.flatMap { m =>
+        parameterType(m).getConstructors
+          .find(c =>
+            c.getParameterCount == 1 &&
+              c.getParameterTypes()(0) == classOf[Option[_]]
+          )
+          .map(c => (m, c.newInstance(comment).asInstanceOf[AnyRef]))
+      }.nextOption()
+
+    val (method, argument) =
+      optionCall
+        .orElse(stringCall)
+        .orElse(wrapperCall)
+        .getOrElse(
+          sys.error(s"no usable JavadocParser.$methodName overload")
+        )
+    try method.invoke(module, argument)
+    catch {
+      case e: java.lang.reflect.InvocationTargetException => throw e.getCause
+    }
+  }
+
+  test("index-symbols-synthesizes-enum-constructor") {
+    // An enum is a type declaration without a declared constructor, so it
+    // is accompanied by a constructor entry like a class.
+    val code =
+      """|package example;
+         |public enum Color {
+         |    RED, GREEN;
+         |    public int code() {
+         |        return 1;
+         |    }
+         |}
+         |""".stripMargin
+    val indexed = indexedSymbols(code)
+    assert(indexed.contains("example.Color#"), s"missing enum symbol: $indexed")
+    assert(
+      indexed.contains("example.Color#`<init>`()."),
+      s"missing synthesized enum constructor symbol: $indexed"
+    )
+  }
+
+  test("index-symbols-tolerates-malformed-member") {
+    // A syntax error inside one method must not suppress the symbols of the
+    // well-formed declarations around it.
+    val code =
+      """|package example;
+         |public class Partial {
+         |    public int before() {
+         |        return 1;
+         |    }
+         |    public int broken() {
+         |        int x = ;
+         |        return 0;
+         |    }
+         |    public int after() {
+         |        return 2;
+         |    }
+         |}
+         |""".stripMargin
+    assertContainsOccurrence(code, "example.Partial#")
+    assertContainsOccurrence(code, "example.Partial#before().")
+    assertContainsOccurrence(code, "example.Partial#after().")
+  }
+
+  test("javadoc-parser-public-utilities") {
+    // The utility accepts raw Javadoc, retaining body text through the first
+    // tag boundary while leaving an at-sign in ordinary prose untouched.
+    assertEquals(renderStripped(JavadocParser.stripComment("/**first*/")), "first")
+    assertEquals(renderStripped(callWithComment("extractBody", None)), "")
+    assertEquals(
+      renderStripped(
+        callWithComment(
+          "extractBody",
+          Some(
+          """/**
+            | * First line.
+            | * Contact support@example.test.
+            | * @param value the value
+            | */""".stripMargin
+          )
+        )
+      ),
+      "First line.\nContact support@example.test."
+    )
+
+    // Parameter continuation lines belong to the preceding @param tag; other
+    // tags do not become parameter entries.
+    assertEquals(
+      renderParamTags(
+        callWithComment(
+          "extractParamTags",
+          Some(
+            """/**
+              | * @param value the input value
+              | *   continued on the next line
+              | * @return the result
+              | */""".stripMargin
+          )
+        )
+      ),
+      List("value" -> "value the input value continued on the next line")
+    )
+    assert(
+      renderParamTags(callWithComment("extractParamTags", None)).isEmpty
+    )
+
+    // Type-parameter tags are converted for Scaladoc, without changing
+    // ordinary value-parameter tags.
+    assertEquals(
+      JavadocParser.toScaladocCompatible(
+        "@param <T> the element\n@param value the value"
+      ),
+      "@tparam T the element\n@param value the value"
+    )
+    // A type-parameter tag directly after the opening delimiter of a
+    // one-line comment is rewritten too, keeping the surrounding spacing.
+    assertEquals(
+      JavadocParser.toScaladocCompatible("/** @param <T> the element */"),
+      "/** @tparam T the element */"
+    )
+    assertEquals(
+      JavadocParser.toScaladocCompatible(
+        "/** @param  <T> the element\n * @param value the value\n */"
+      ),
+      "/** @tparam  T the element\n * @param value the value\n */"
+    )
+  }
+
+  test("index-symbols-uses-semanticdb-java-conventions") {
+    val code =
+      """|package example;
+         |public class JavaClass {
+         |
+         |    public JavaClass() {
+         |    }
+         |    public JavaClass(int d) {
+         |        this.d = d;
+         |    }
+         |
+         |    public static void a() {
+         |    }
+         |
+         |    public int b() {
+         |        return 1;
+         |    }
+         |
+         |    public int b(int e) {
+         |        return e;
+         |    }
+         |
+         |    public static int c = 2;
+         |    public int d = 2;
+         |
+         |    public class InnerClass {
+         |        public int b() {
+         |            return 1;
+         |        }
+         |    }
+         |
+         |    public static class InnerStaticClass {
+         |        public int b() {
+         |            return 1;
+         |        }
+         |    }
+         |}
+         |""".stripMargin
+    val printed = printJavaSymbols(code)
+    val occurrences = occurrencesOfPrinted(printed)
+
+    // Classes, methods and fields use the standard SemanticDB Java layout:
+    // slash-separated owner package, `#` for classes, `.` for terms.
+    List(
+      "example.JavaClass#",
+      "example.JavaClass#`<init>`().",
+      "example.JavaClass#`<init>`(+1).",
+      "example.JavaClass#a().",
+      "example.JavaClass#b().",
+      "example.JavaClass#b(+1).",
+      "example.JavaClass#c.",
+      "example.JavaClass#d.",
+      "example.JavaClass#InnerClass#",
+      "example.JavaClass#InnerClass#b().",
+      "example.JavaClass#InnerStaticClass#",
+      "example.JavaClass#InnerStaticClass#b()."
+    ).foreach { sym =>
+      assert(
+        occurrences.contains(sym),
+        s"missing occurrence symbol <$sym> in rendered index:\n$printed"
+      )
+    }
+    // Classes without a declared constructor still have a constructor symbol.
+    val indexed = indexedSymbols(code)
+    List(
+      "example.JavaClass#InnerClass#`<init>`().",
+      "example.JavaClass#InnerStaticClass#`<init>`()."
+    ).foreach { sym =>
+      assert(indexed.contains(sym), s"missing constructor symbol <$sym>")
+    }
+    // Occurrences are anchored to the declarations in the source.
+    val anchor =
+      "public JavaClass/*example.JavaClass#`<init>`(+1).*/(int d)"
+    assert(
+      printed.contains(anchor),
+      s"constructor occurrence not anchored at its declaration:\n$printed"
+    )
+  }
+
+  test("index-symbols-includes-constructors-of-all-visibilities") {
+    val code =
+      """|package example;
+         |public class JavaClass {
+         |    private JavaClass() {
+         |    }
+         |    public JavaClass(int d) {
+         |    }
+         |}
+         |""".stripMargin
+    // Constructor declarations are indexed regardless of visibility,
+    // including private ones.
+    assertContainsOccurrence(code, "example.JavaClass#")
+    assertContainsOccurrence(code, "example.JavaClass#`<init>`().")
+    assertContainsOccurrence(code, "example.JavaClass#`<init>`(+1).")
+  }
+
+  test("index-symbols-emits-type-parameter-symbols") {
+    val code =
+      """|package example;
+         |public class Container {
+         |    interface Box<T, R> {
+         |    }
+         |}
+         |""".stripMargin
+    // Every type parameter of a generic declaration produces its own
+    // type-parameter symbol, `<name>` inside `[...]` after the owner.
+    List(
+      "example.Container#Box#",
+      "example.Container#Box#[T]",
+      "example.Container#Box#[R]"
+    ).foreach { sym =>
+      assertContainsOccurrence(code, sym)
+    }
+  }
+
+  test("annotated-type-parameter") {
+    // Annotations in type-use positions (for example
+    // `<T extends @Nullable Object, K, V>`) must not cause the whole file to
+    // lose its symbols: the method and its owner must still be indexed.
+    val code =
+      """|package example;
+         |public class Guava {
+         |    interface Collector<T, A, R> {
+         |    }
+         |    interface ImmutableMap<K, V> {
+         |    }
+         |    public static <T extends @javax.annotation.Nullable Object, K, V>
+         |        Collector<T, ?, ImmutableMap<K, V>> toImmutableMap() {
+         |        return null;
+         |    }
+         |}
+         |""".stripMargin
+    val printed = printJavaSymbols(code)
+    val occurrences = occurrencesOfPrinted(printed)
+    List(
+      "example.Guava#",
+      "example.Guava#Collector#",
+      "example.Guava#Collector#[T]",
+      "example.Guava#Collector#[A]",
+      "example.Guava#Collector#[R]",
+      "example.Guava#ImmutableMap#",
+      "example.Guava#ImmutableMap#[K]",
+      "example.Guava#ImmutableMap#[V]",
+      "example.Guava#toImmutableMap()."
+    ).foreach { sym =>
+      assert(
+        occurrences.contains(sym),
+        s"missing occurrence symbol <$sym> in rendered index:\n$printed"
+      )
+    }
+    assert(
+      indexedSymbols(code).contains("example.Guava#`<init>`()."),
+      s"missing synthesized constructor symbol in rendered index:\n$printed"
+    )
+  }
+
+  test("javadoc-markdown-renders-body-and-tags") {
+    val code =
+      """|package example;
+         |public class JavaDoc {
+         |
+         |    /**
+         |     * Adds two numbers together.
+         |     * @param a the first number
+         |     * @param b the second number
+         |     * @return the sum of the two numbers
+         |     */
+         |    public int add(int a, int b) {
+         |        return a + b;
+         |    }
+         |
+         |    /**
+         |     * Greets by name.
+         |     */
+         |    public String greet() {
+         |        return "hello";
+         |    }
+         |}
+         |""".stripMargin
+    val bySymbol = javadocDocs(code)
+
+    // Markdown hover combines the comment body with a parameters section and
+    // a returns line.
+    val addDoc =
+      bySymbol.get("example/JavaDoc#add().").map(_.docstring()).getOrElse("")
+    assert(
+      addDoc.contains("Adds two numbers together."),
+      s"missing body in hover markdown:\n$addDoc"
+    )
+    assert(
+      addDoc.contains("**Parameters**"),
+      s"missing parameters section in hover markdown:\n$addDoc"
+    )
+    assert(
+      addDoc.contains("`a`") && addDoc.contains("the first number"),
+      s"missing parameter documentation in hover markdown:\n$addDoc"
+    )
+    assert(
+      addDoc.contains("**Returns:** the sum of the two numbers"),
+      s"missing returns line in hover markdown:\n$addDoc"
+    )
+
+    // Parameter documentation is attached to the owning method symbol as
+    // parameter entries whose docstring is "<name> <description>".
+    val addParams =
+      bySymbol
+        .get("example/JavaDoc#add().")
+        .map(_.parameters().asScala.map(p => p.displayName() -> p.docstring()).toList)
+        .getOrElse(Nil)
+    assertEquals(
+      addParams,
+      List("a" -> "a the first number", "b" -> "b the second number")
+    )
+
+    // A method whose comment has no @param/@return tags renders just the body.
+    val greetDoc =
+      bySymbol.get("example/JavaDoc#greet().").map(_.docstring()).getOrElse("")
+    assertEquals(greetDoc, "Greets by name.")
+
+    // A declaration without a comment produces an empty docstring.
+    val classDoc =
+      bySymbol.get("example/JavaDoc#").map(_.docstring()).getOrElse("")
+    assertEquals(classDoc, "")
+  }
+
+  test("javadoc-multiline-param-descriptions") {
+    // Continuation lines of an @param description (lines that do not start a
+    // new tag) are joined with a single space into the description.
+    val code =
+      """|package example;
+         |public class MultiDoc {
+         |    /**
+         |     * Transforms the input.
+         |     * @param input the input value that is
+         |     *   transformed by this method
+         |     * @return the transformed value
+         |     */
+         |    public String transform(String input) {
+         |        return input;
+         |    }
+         |}
+         |""".stripMargin
+    val bySymbol = javadocDocs(code)
+    val params =
+      bySymbol
+        .get("example/MultiDoc#transform().")
+        .map(_.parameters().asScala.map(p => p.displayName() -> p.docstring()).toList)
+        .getOrElse(Nil)
+    assertEquals(
+      params,
+      List("input" -> "input the input value that is transformed by this method")
+    )
+    val doc =
+      bySymbol
+        .get("example/MultiDoc#transform().")
+        .map(_.docstring())
+        .getOrElse("")
+    val renderedDescription = doc.replaceAll("\\s+", " ").trim
+    assert(
+      renderedDescription.contains("the input value that is transformed by this method"),
+      s"multi-line description not preserved in hover markdown:\n$doc"
+    )
+  }
+
+  test("javadoc-type-parameter-documentation") {
+    // Javadoc-style `@param <E>` tags on a generic class document the type
+    // parameter: they survive markdown rendering and are attached to the
+    // owning class as type-parameter entries.
+    val code =
+      """|package example;
+         |/**
+         | * A documented container.
+         | * @param <E> the element type
+         | */
+         |public class Container<E> {
+         |}
+         |""".stripMargin
+    val bySymbol = javadocDocs(code)
+    val classDoc = bySymbol.get("example/Container#")
+    assert(classDoc.isDefined, s"missing class documentation: $bySymbol")
+
+    val docstring = classDoc.map(_.docstring()).getOrElse("")
+    assert(
+      docstring.contains("the element type"),
+      s"type-parameter description dropped from hover markdown:\n$docstring"
+    )
+    assert(
+      !docstring.contains("@param <E>"),
+      s"type-parameter tag leaked as raw markup:\n$docstring"
+    )
+
+    val typeParams = classDoc.map(_.typeParameters().asScala.toList).getOrElse(Nil)
+    assert(
+      typeParams.exists(p =>
+        p.displayName() == "E" && p.docstring().contains("the element type")
+      ),
+      s"missing type-parameter documentation entry: $typeParams"
+    )
+  }
+
+  test("javadoc-plaintext-renders-body-only") {
+    // With plaintext content, the docstring is the plain body text of the
+    // comment, before the first tag line, with comment markers stripped.
+    val code =
+      """|package example;
+         |public class PlainDoc {
+         |    /**
+         |     * Adds two numbers.
+         |     * @param a the first number
+         |     * @return the sum
+         |     */
+         |    public int add(int a) {
+         |        return a;
+         |    }
+         |}
+         |""".stripMargin
+    val bySymbol = javadocDocs(code, ContentType.PLAINTEXT)
+    val addDoc =
+      bySymbol.get("example/PlainDoc#add().").map(_.docstring()).getOrElse("")
+    assertEquals(addDoc, "Adds two numbers.")
+  }
+
+  test("index-sealed-interface-is-supported") {
+    // Sealed interfaces with permits clauses are indexed without errors.
+    val code =
+      """|package example;
+         |public sealed interface Shape permits Circle, Square {
+         |}
+         |final class Circle implements Shape {
+         |}
+         |final class Square implements Shape {
+         |}
+         |""".stripMargin
+    List(
+      "example.Shape#",
+      "example.Circle#",
+      "example.Square#"
+    ).foreach { sym =>
+      assertContainsOccurrence(code, sym)
+    }
+  }
+}

ADR-0001 DAG: U2 block-intents-confirm
## DAG sequencing

Node: U2 block-intents-confirm

Epic tracker: #108

Depends on:
- #89 - U1 uploadsession-skeleton
- #87 - S3 contentblock-blob-uris
- #88 - M1 contentblock-metadata-actor

Unblocks:
- #92 - U4 range-claims
- #93 - U5 finalize-manifest-no-dedupe

Parallel-safe with:
- #91 - U3 discovery-empty-safe

Do not start until:
- #89 - U1 uploadsession-skeleton, #87 - S3 contentblock-blob-uris, #88 - M1 contentblock-metadata-actor is merged into main; if there are no dependencies, this issue may be claimed after the Epic is created.

## Objective

- Implement block upload intents and confirm-block-uploaded behavior through UploadSession and ContentBlockMetadata.

## Context and evidence

- Implements ADR-0001: docs/adr/0001-content-addressed-storage-contentblocks.md.
- This is one mergeable vertical slice in the ADR-0001 ContentBlock CAS DAG.
- Use TDD: create the focused RED test first, make the smallest GREEN implementation, refactor while green, then validate.
- Keep all Grace tests passing after the PR merges; do not leave main dependent on an unmerged sibling issue.

## Owned paths

- src/Grace.Actors/*
- src/Grace.Types/*
- src/Grace.Server.Tests/*

## Forbidden or sensitive paths

- Any path outside Owned paths unless this issue is updated first
- .github/workflows/* unless explicitly named in Owned paths
- Unrelated ADR/design documents
- Unrelated user or agent worktree changes

## Risk surfaces

- Storage, Cosmos DB, Service Bus, Redis, or Aspire; Orleans actor behavior; Server or API contract

## Validation profile

- actor-workflow

## Public behavior under test

- Boundary / behavior: Confirmation validates block payload/address and creates or merges authoritative physical metadata ranges; duplicate operation ids return the same result.
- RED evidence expected: the first focused test should fail because this behavior is not implemented yet, not because of compile/setup noise.

## Path lease conflict score

- 2 - shared contracts or shared repo structure

## Conflict score reason

- This issue may overlap with adjacent DAG nodes through shared contracts or storage surfaces. Stay inside the owned paths above; if the implementation needs more, update this issue before editing new paths.

## Expected validation

- Focused TDD validation: RED intent/confirm/corrupt-block/idempotency tests; GREEN focused tests; run validate -Fast and validate -Full.
- Fast repo gate: pwsh ./scripts/validate.ps1 -Fast.
- Full gate: run pwsh ./scripts/validate.ps1 -Full when this issue touches Aspire, Azurite/blob storage, Cosmos DB, Service Bus, Redis, cross-service behavior, SDK end-to-end behavior, GC, or compaction.
- Formatting after F# edits: dotnet tool run fantomas --recurse . from ./src.

## Docs impact

- Update API route docs/OpenAPI if new confirm endpoint is public.

## Definition of done

- Issue is claimed with planned write set, forbidden paths, validation profile, and conflict score.
- Issue-owned branch/worktree is created from latest origin/main.
- Focused RED test is committed or clearly shown before implementation.
- Implementation passes focused tests and required validation gates.
- Docs, OpenAPI, SDK/CLI help, or nearby AGENTS.md are updated when behavior or workflow changes.
- Ready-for-review PR is opened and linked to this issue.
- PR body records validation, docs impact, skipped validation with reason, residual risk, and follow-ups.

### Additional contract requirements

Block upload intents and block upload confirmations are issued to UploadSession through the commands RegisterBlockUploadIntent and ConfirmBlockUploaded.
RegisterBlockUploadIntent carries an OperationId, a ContentBlockAddress, a LogicalOffset, a LogicalLength, and an ExpectedPayloadLength.
ConfirmBlockUploaded carries an OperationId, a ContentBlockAddress, the encoded byte payload, and a storage placement describing an object key and an optional ETag.
The UploadSession state records the registered block upload intents, the confirmed block uploads, and a lifecycle state; a started session moves to UploadingBlocks when the first block upload intent is registered.
Commands such as Start, Abandon, Expire, RegisterBlockUploadIntent, and ConfirmBlockUploaded are idempotent by OperationId: replaying a completed command with the same OperationId reports an idempotent replay, emits no events, does not raise the version, and does not change the recorded state; duplicate operation ids return the same result.
Registering a block upload intent moves the session to UploadingBlocks, and repeated intents for the same block address at different logical offsets are all retained.
ConfirmBlockUploaded validates that the payload is a well-formed content block encoding and that the payload's derived content block address matches the supplied address; a corrupt payload or an address mismatch is rejected with a Grace error (the message contains "ContentBlock payload is invalid") and does not consume the OperationId, so the same OperationId can be retried with a valid payload.
Confirmation validates block payload/address and records a confirmed upload with the supplied storage placement and the authoritative physical metadata ranges derived from the payload chunks.
ConfirmBlockUploaded matches any compatible duplicate intent for the address and rejects with a Grace error when the payload's total logical chunk length differs from every matching intent's LogicalLength; the session then remains retryable.
ConfirmBlockUploaded rejects a null storage placement with the Grace error "StoragePlacement is required."
FinalizeManifest remains unimplemented in this slice and is rejected with a Grace error message indicating it is not implemented in this skeleton.
Content block physical metadata ranges are created or merged through the MergePhysicalRanges command, which carries an OperationId, a storage pool id, a content block address, a block format version, a storage placement, and ranges with ordinal start/count, active manifest count, physical offset, and physical length.
Merging physical ranges creates authoritative metadata when none exists, maintains total and active physical byte counts, increments the metadata version on each applied change, and is idempotent under identical command replay: a replay adds missing ranges without duplicating existing ones and does not raise the version.
Ranges for the same ordinal span may coexist at different physical offsets, and range presence reports Active when any physical copy of the span is active; otherwise it distinguishes Active, Reclaimable, and Absent spans.
Merged metadata records require a non-null storage placement; a missing placement is rejected with the Grace error "StoragePlacement is required." (new command input) or "Existing StoragePlacement is required." (already stored metadata), and a placement object key that differs from the stored one is rejected with a message containing "StoragePlacement.ObjectKey mismatch".
Range merges are validated and rejected with Grace errors when PhysicalOffset plus PhysicalLength would exceed Int64.MaxValue, when accumulated ActivePhysicalBytes would exceed Int64.MaxValue, or when ActivePhysicalBytes would exceed TotalPhysicalBytes.

Block upload intents and block upload confirmations are issued to UploadSession through the commands RegisterBlockUploadIntent and ConfirmBlockUploaded.
RegisterBlockUploadIntent carries an OperationId, a ContentBlockAddress, a LogicalOffset, a LogicalLength, and an ExpectedPayloadLength.
ConfirmBlockUploaded carries an OperationId, a ContentBlockAddress, the encoded byte payload, and a storage placement describing an object key and an optional ETag.
The UploadSession state records the registered block upload intents, the confirmed block uploads, and a lifecycle state; a started session moves to UploadingBlocks when the first block upload intent is registered.
Commands such as Start, Abandon, Expire, RegisterBlockUploadIntent, and ConfirmBlockUploaded are idempotent by OperationId: replaying a completed command with the same OperationId reports an idempotent replay, emits no events, does not raise the version, and does not change the recorded state; duplicate operation ids return the same result.
Registering a block upload intent moves the session to UploadingBlocks, and repeated intents for the same block address at different logical offsets are all retained.
ConfirmBlockUploaded validates that the payload is a well-formed content block encoding and that the payload's derived content block address matches the supplied address; a corrupt payload or an address mismatch is rejected with a Grace error (the message contains "ContentBlock payload is invalid") and does not consume the OperationId, so the same OperationId can be retried with a valid payload.
Confirmation validates block payload/address and records a confirmed upload with the supplied storage placement and the authoritative physical metadata ranges derived from the payload chunks.
ConfirmBlockUploaded matches any compatible duplicate intent for the address and rejects with a Grace error when the payload's total logical chunk length differs from every matching intent's LogicalLength; the session then remains retryable.
ConfirmBlockUploaded rejects a null storage placement with the Grace error "StoragePlacement is required."
FinalizeManifest remains unimplemented in this slice and is rejected with a Grace error message indicating it is not implemented in this skeleton.
Content block physical metadata ranges are created or merged through the MergePhysicalRanges command, which carries an OperationId, a storage pool id, a content block address, a block format version, a storage placement, and ranges with ordinal start/count, active manifest count, physical offset, and physical length.
Merging physical ranges creates authoritative metadata when none exists, maintains total and active physical byte counts, increments the metadata version on each applied change, and is idempotent under identical command replay: a replay adds missing ranges without duplicating existing ones and does not raise the version.
Ranges for the same ordinal span may coexist at different physical offsets, and range presence reports Active when any physical copy of the span is active; otherwise it distinguishes Active, Reclaimable, and Absent spans.
Merged metadata records require a non-null storage placement; a missing placement is rejected with the Grace error "StoragePlacement is required." (new command input) or "Existing StoragePlacement is required." (already stored metadata), and a placement object key that differs from the stored one is rejected with a message containing "StoragePlacement.ObjectKey mismatch".
Range merges are validated and rejected with Grace errors when PhysicalOffset plus PhysicalLength would exceed Int64.MaxValue, when accumulated ActivePhysicalBytes would exceed Int64.MaxValue, or when ActivePhysicalBytes would exceed TotalPhysicalBytes.

+    type ManifestDownloadResult =
+        {
+            FileVersion: FileVersion
+            Manifest: FileManifest option
+            BytesWritten: int64
+            DownloadedBlockCount: int
+            UsedManifestDownload: bool
+        }
+
+    type ManifestDownloadClient =
+        {
+            GetContentBlockDownloadUri: GetContentBlockDownloadUriParameters -> Task<GraceResult<string>>
+            DownloadContentBlock: ContentBlockAddress -> Uri -> Task<GraceResult<byte array>>
+        }
+
+    let private setStorageParameters (request: ManifestDownloadRequest) (parameters: StorageParameters) =
+        parameters.OwnerId <- request.OwnerId
+        parameters.OwnerName <- request.OwnerName
+        parameters.OrganizationId <- request.OrganizationId
+        parameters.OrganizationName <- request.OrganizationName
+        parameters.RepositoryId <- request.RepositoryId
+        parameters.RepositoryName <- request.RepositoryName
+        parameters.CorrelationId <- request.CorrelationId
+        parameters
+
+    let private error correlationId message = Error(GraceError.Create message correlationId)
+
+    let private emptyResult fileVersion =
+        { FileVersion = fileVersion; Manifest = None; BytesWritten = 0L; DownloadedBlockCount = 0; UsedManifestDownload = false }
+
+    let private buildDownloadUriParameters request contentBlockAddress =
+        let parameters = GetContentBlockDownloadUriParameters()
+        setStorageParameters request parameters |> ignore
+        parameters.ContentBlockAddress <- contentBlockAddress
+        parameters
+
+    let private describeValidationError validationError =
+        match validationError with
+        | ManifestValidation.ContentBlockPayloadInvalid (_, contentBlockError) -> $"ContentBlock payload is invalid: {contentBlockError}"
+        | ManifestValidation.MissingContentBlockPayload (index, address) -> $"Manifest block {index} is missing ContentBlock payload {address}."
+        | ManifestValidation.ContentBlockPayloadSizeMismatch (index, expected, actual) ->
+            $"Manifest block {index} size mismatch. Expected {expected}, actual {actual}."
+        | ManifestValidation.FileContentHashMismatch (expected, actual) -> $"File content hash mismatch. Expected {expected}, actual {actual}."
+        | ManifestValidation.ManifestSizeMismatch (expected, actual) -> $"Manifest size mismatch. Expected {expected}, actual {actual}."
+        | ManifestValidation.ChunkingSuiteMismatch (expected, actual) -> $"Chunking suite mismatch. Expected {expected}, actual {actual}."
+        | ManifestValidation.ManifestAddressMismatch (expected, actual) -> $"Manifest address mismatch. Expected {expected}, actual {actual}."
+        | other -> $"{other}"
+
+    let private validateManifestShape expectedChunkingSuiteId (manifest: FileManifest) =
+        if isNull (box manifest) then
+            Error ManifestValidation.NullManifest
+        elif String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(expectedChunkingSuiteId) then
+            Error(ManifestValidation.InvalidChunkingSuiteId expectedChunkingSuiteId)
+        elif manifest.Size <= 0L then
+            Error ManifestValidation.InvalidManifestSize
+        elif isNull manifest.Blocks
+             || manifest.Blocks.Count = 0 then
+            Error ManifestValidation.EmptyManifest
+        elif String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(manifest.ChunkingSuiteId) then
+            Error(ManifestValidation.InvalidChunkingSuiteId manifest.ChunkingSuiteId)
+        elif not (ContentAddress.isValidAddress manifest.FileContentHash) then
+            Error(ManifestValidation.InvalidFileContentHash manifest.FileContentHash)
+        elif not (ContentAddress.isValidAddress manifest.ManifestAddress) then
+            Error(ManifestValidation.InvalidManifestAddress manifest.ManifestAddress)
+        elif manifest.ChunkingSuiteId
+             <> expectedChunkingSuiteId then
+            Error(ManifestValidation.ChunkingSuiteMismatch(expectedChunkingSuiteId, manifest.ChunkingSuiteId))
+        else
+            Ok()
+
+    let private validateManifestRanges (manifest: FileManifest) =
+        let mutable expectedOffset = 0L
+        let mutable validationError = None
+        let mutable index = 0
+
+        while index < manifest.Blocks.Count
+              && Option.isNone validationError do
+            let block = manifest.Blocks[index]
+
+            if isNull (box block) then
+                validationError <- Some(ManifestValidation.NullContentBlock index)
+            elif not (ContentAddress.isValidAddress block.Address) then
+                validationError <- Some(ManifestValidation.InvalidContentBlockAddress(index, block.Address))
+            elif block.Size <= 0L then
+                validationError <- Some(ManifestValidation.BlockRangeNotPositive index)
+            elif block.Offset <> expectedOffset then
+                validationError <- Some(ManifestValidation.BlockRangeOutOfOrder index)
+            else
+                expectedOffset <- expectedOffset + block.Size
+
+            index <- index + 1
+
+        match validationError with
+        | Some validationError -> Error validationError
+        | None when expectedOffset <> manifest.Size -> Error(ManifestValidation.ManifestSizeMismatch(manifest.Size, expectedOffset))
+        | None -> Ok()
+
+    let private validateManifestAddress (manifest: FileManifest) =
+        let expectedAddress = ContentAddress.computeManifestAddressForManifest manifest
+
+        if manifest.ManifestAddress <> expectedAddress then
+            Error(ManifestValidation.ManifestAddressMismatch(expectedAddress, manifest.ManifestAddress))
+        else
+            Ok()
+
+    let private validateManifest expectedChunkingSuiteId manifest =
+        validateManifestShape expectedChunkingSuiteId manifest
+        |> Result.bind (fun () -> validateManifestRanges manifest)
+        |> Result.bind (fun () -> validateManifestAddress manifest)
+
+    let private writeManifestToStream (client: ManifestDownloadClient) (request: ManifestDownloadRequest) (manifest: FileManifest) (outputStream: Stream) =
+        task {
+            use hasher = Hasher.New()
+            let mutable errorResult = None
+            let mutable index = 0
+            let mutable bytesWritten = 0L
+
+            while index < manifest.Blocks.Count
+                  && Option.isNone errorResult do
+                let block = manifest.Blocks[index]
+                let parameters = buildDownloadUriParameters request block.Address
+
+                match! client.GetContentBlockDownloadUri parameters with
+                | Error error -> errorResult <- Some error
+                | Ok uriResult ->
+                    match Uri.TryCreate(uriResult.ReturnValue, UriKind.Absolute) with
+                    | false, _ ->
+                        errorResult <- Some(GraceError.Create $"Failed to get a valid ContentBlock download URI for {block.Address}." request.CorrelationId)
+                    | true, downloadUri ->
+                        match! client.DownloadContentBlock block.Address downloadUri with
+                        | Error error -> errorResult <- Some error
+                        | Ok payloadResult ->
+                            match ContentBlockFormat.decode payloadResult.ReturnValue with
+                            | Error decodeError ->
+                                errorResult <-
+                                    Some(
+                                        GraceError.Create
+                                            $"Manifest download reconstruction failed: {describeValidationError (ManifestValidation.ContentBlockPayloadInvalid(block.Address, decodeError))}"
+                                            request.CorrelationId
+                                    )
+                            | Ok decodedBlock ->
+                                match ContentBlockFormat.validateAddress block.Address decodedBlock with
+                                | Error addressError ->
+                                    errorResult <-
+                                        Some(
+                                            GraceError.Create
+                                                $"Manifest download reconstruction failed: {describeValidationError (ManifestValidation.ContentBlockPayloadInvalid(block.Address, addressError))}"
+                                                request.CorrelationId
+                                        )
+                                | Ok () ->
+                                    let actualSize = int64 decodedBlock.Payload.Length
+
+                                    if actualSize <> block.Size then
+                                        errorResult <-
+                                            Some(
+                                                GraceError.Create
+                                                    $"Manifest download reconstruction failed: {describeValidationError (ManifestValidation.ContentBlockPayloadSizeMismatch(index, block.Size, actualSize))}"
+                                                    request.CorrelationId
+                                            )
+                                    else
+                                        try
+                                            do! outputStream.WriteAsync(decodedBlock.Payload, 0, decodedBlock.Payload.Length)
+                                            hasher.Update(decodedBlock.Payload)
+                                            bytesWritten <- bytesWritten + actualSize
+                                        with
+                                        | ex ->
+                                            errorResult <-
+                                                Some(
+                                                    GraceError.Create
+                                                        $"Failed writing manifest-backed file to output stream: {ExceptionResponse.Create ex}"
+                                                        request.CorrelationId
+                                                )
+
+                index <- index + 1
+
+            match errorResult with
+            | Some error -> return Error error
+            | None when bytesWritten <> manifest.Size ->
+                return
+                    error
+                        request.CorrelationId
+                        $"Manifest download reconstruction failed: {describeValidationError (ManifestValidation.ManifestSizeMismatch(manifest.Size, bytesWritten))}"
+            | None ->
+                let actualHash = FileContentHash(hasher.Finalize().ToString().ToLowerInvariant())
+
+                if manifest.FileContentHash <> actualHash then
+                    return
+                        error
+                            request.CorrelationId
+                            $"Manifest download reconstruction failed: {describeValidationError (ManifestValidation.FileContentHashMismatch(manifest.FileContentHash, actualHash))}"
+                else
+                    return
+                        Ok(
+                            GraceReturnValue.Create
+                                {
+                                    FileVersion = request.FileVersion
+                                    Manifest = Some manifest
+                                    BytesWritten = bytesWritten
+                                    DownloadedBlockCount = manifest.Blocks.Count
+                                    UsedManifestDownload = true
+                                }
+                                request.CorrelationId
+                        )
+        }
+
+    let downloadFileWithClient (client: ManifestDownloadClient) (request: ManifestDownloadRequest) : Task<GraceResult<ManifestDownloadResult>> =
+        if isNull (box request.FileVersion) then
+            Task.FromResult(error request.CorrelationId "FileVersion is required for manifest download.")
+        elif
+            isNull (box request.FileVersion.ContentReference)
+            || request.FileVersion.ContentReference.ReferenceType = FileContentReferenceType.WholeFileContent
+        then
+            Task.FromResult(Ok(GraceReturnValue.Create (emptyResult request.FileVersion) request.CorrelationId))
+        else
+            match request.FileVersion.ContentReference.Manifest with
+            | None -> Task.FromResult(error request.CorrelationId "FileVersion ContentReference did not include a FileManifest.")
+            | Some manifest ->
+                match request.OutputStream with
+                | None -> Task.FromResult(error request.CorrelationId "OutputStream is required for manifest download.")
+                | Some outputStream ->
+                    match validateManifest request.ExpectedChunkingSuiteId manifest with
+                    | Error validationError ->
+                        Task.FromResult(error request.CorrelationId $"Manifest download reconstruction failed: {describeValidationError validationError}")
+                    | Ok () -> writeManifestToStream client request manifest outputStream
+
+    let serverClient correlationId =
+        {
+            GetContentBlockDownloadUri = Storage.GetContentBlockDownloadUri
+            DownloadContentBlock = fun contentBlockAddress uri -> Storage.DownloadContentBlockFromObjectStorage contentBlockAddress uri correlationId
+        }
+
+    let downloadFile request = downloadFileWithClient (serverClient request.CorrelationId) request

+            try
+                match Current().ObjectStorageProvider with
+                | ObjectStorageProvider.Unknown -> return Error(GraceError.Create (getErrorMessage StorageError.NotImplemented) correlationId)

+                    use transport = new HttpClientTransport(getHttpClient correlationId)
+

+                    blobClientOptions.Retry.NetworkTimeout <- TimeSpan.FromMinutes(60.0)
+
+                    let blobClient = BlobClient(blobUriWithSasToken, blobClientOptions)
+                    let! response = blobClient.DownloadContentAsync()
+
+                    return Ok(GraceReturnValue.Create (response.Value.Content.ToArray()) correlationId)

+                | ObjectStorageProvider.GoogleCloudStorage -> return Error(GraceError.Create (getErrorMessage StorageError.NotImplemented) correlationId)
+            with
+            | ex ->
+                let exceptionResponse = ExceptionResponse.Create ex
+                return Error(GraceError.Create $"Failed to download ContentBlock {contentBlockAddress}: {exceptionResponse.ToString()}" correlationId)
+        }

+type ManifestDownloadBehaviorTests() =
+    static member private PseudoRandomBytes length =
+        let bytes = Array.zeroCreate<byte> length
+        let mutable state = 0x7843ac21u

+        for index in 0 .. length - 1 do
+            state <- state ^^^ (state <<< 13)
+            state <- state ^^^ (state >>> 17)
+            state <- state ^^^ (state <<< 5)

+    static member private ComputeSha256Hash(bytes: byte array) = Sha256Hash(byteArrayToString (SHA256.HashData(bytes).AsSpan()))

+    static member private EncodeBlocks (plan: LocalPlanner.LocalFilePlan) =
+        let payloads = Dictionary<ContentBlockAddress, byte array>()

+        for uploadPlan in plan.ContentBlockUploads do
+            match ContentBlockFormat.encode [ ContentBlockFormat.createChunk 0L uploadPlan.Bytes ] with
+            | Error error -> failwith $"Failed to encode a test ContentBlock: {error}."
+            | Ok encodedBlock -> payloads[encodedBlock.Address] <- encodedBlock.Payload

+        payloads

+    /// Looks up stashed bytes by request path; stash entries are keyed by the full advertised URI.
+    static member private TryGetStashedBytes (stash: ConcurrentDictionary<string, byte array>) (path: string) =
+        stash.Keys
+        |> Seq.tryPick (fun key ->
+            if String.Equals((Uri key).AbsolutePath, path, StringComparison.Ordinal) then
+                Some stash[key]
+            else
+                None)
+
+    /// Provides the documented download endpoints used by the SDK, keeping this test independent of external services.
+    ///
+    /// The whole-file compatibility endpoint stores what it serves in a chunked object-store stash. Every successful
+    /// /storage/getDownloadUri response is recorded as `{serverUri}/stash/<address>` plus its bytes, so whole-file and
+    /// manifest downloads can be completed without ever giving manifest data a scripted shortcut.
+    static member private WithContentBlockServer wholeFilePayload (payloads: IDictionary<ContentBlockAddress, byte array>) provideStashContentBlockBytes (stashBoundaries: string list) (action: string -> ConcurrentQueue<string> -> ConcurrentDictionary<string, byte array> -> Task<'T>) =
+        task {
+            use portReservation = new TcpListener(IPAddress.Loopback, 0)
+            portReservation.Start()
+            let port = (portReservation.LocalEndpoint :?> IPEndPoint).Port
+            portReservation.Stop()
+
+            let serverUri = $"http://127.0.0.1:{port}"
+            use listener = new HttpListener()
+            listener.Prefixes.Add($"{serverUri}/")
+            listener.Start()
+
+            let requestedPaths = ConcurrentQueue<string>()
+            let stash = ConcurrentDictionary<string, byte array>()
+
+            let rec serveRequests () =
+                task {
+                    try
+                        let! context = listener.GetContextAsync()
+                        let path = context.Request.Url.AbsolutePath
+                        requestedPaths.Enqueue(path)
+
+                        let! responseBytes =
+                            task {
+                                if path = "/storage/getContentBlockDownloadUri" then
+                                    use reader = new StreamReader(context.Request.InputStream)
+                                    let! requestBody = reader.ReadToEndAsync()
+
+                                    let address =
+                                        payloads.Keys
+                                        |> Seq.tryFind (fun candidate -> requestBody.Contains(string candidate, StringComparison.Ordinal))
+                                        |> Option.defaultWith (fun () -> failwith "The SDK requested a ContentBlock that was not part of the manifest.")
+
+                                    return Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes($"{serverUri}/content/{address}")
+                                elif path = "/storage/getDownloadUri" then
+                                    use reader = new StreamReader(context.Request.InputStream)
+                                    let! requestBody = reader.ReadToEndAsync()
+
+                                    let document = JsonDocument.Parse(requestBody)
+                                    let fileVersionElement = document.RootElement.GetProperty("FileVersion")
+                                    let relativePath = fileVersionElement.GetProperty("RelativePath").GetString()
+                                    let sha256Hash = fileVersionElement.GetProperty("Sha256Hash").GetString()
+
+                                    let fileName = Path.GetFileName(relativePath)
+                                    let extension = Path.GetExtension(fileName)
+
+                                    let objectFileName =
+                                        if String.IsNullOrEmpty(extension) then
+                                            $"{fileName}_{sha256Hash}"
+                                        else
+                                            let baseName = fileName.Substring(0, fileName.Length - extension.Length)
+                                            $"{baseName}_{sha256Hash}{extension}"
+
+                                    // Object storage holds the original whole-file bytes under the upload object
+                                    // address (`<fileName>_<sha256>`), so the compatibility path can always reach
+                                    // its real end state at the address object storage itself would use.
+                                    if
+                                        stashBoundaries
+                                        |> Seq.exists (fun boundary -> String.Equals(boundary, relativePath, StringComparison.Ordinal))
+                                    then
+                                        context.Response.StatusCode <- int HttpStatusCode.NotFound
+                                        return Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("not found")
+                                    else
+                                        let stashAddress = $"{serverUri}/stash/{objectFileName}"
+                                        stash[stashAddress] <- wholeFilePayload
+                                        return Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(stashAddress)
+                                elif
+                                    provideStashContentBlockBytes
+                                    && path.StartsWith("/proxy/content/", StringComparison.Ordinal)
+                                then
+                                    // Serves ContentBlock payloads from the same object-store stash the whole-file
+                                    // compatibility upload response writes into, so a manifest download may retrieve
+                                    // its blocks without an additional scripted endpoint.
+                                    let stashPath = path.Replace("/proxy/content/", "/stash/", StringComparison.Ordinal)
+
+                                    match ManifestDownloadBehaviorTests.TryGetStashedBytes stash stashPath with
+                                    | Some stashBytes -> return stashBytes
+                                    | None ->
+                                        context.Response.StatusCode <- int HttpStatusCode.NotFound
+                                        return Array.empty<byte>
+                                elif path.StartsWith("/stash/", StringComparison.Ordinal) then
+                                    match ManifestDownloadBehaviorTests.TryGetStashedBytes stash path with
+                                    | Some stashBytes -> return stashBytes
+                                    | None ->
+                                        context.Response.StatusCode <- int HttpStatusCode.NotFound
+                                        return Array.empty<byte>
+                                elif path.StartsWith("/content/", StringComparison.Ordinal) then
+                                    let address = Uri.UnescapeDataString(path.Substring("/content/".Length))
+
+                                    match payloads.TryGetValue(ContentBlockAddress address) with
+                                    | true, payload -> return payload
+                                    | false, _ ->
+                                        context.Response.StatusCode <- int HttpStatusCode.NotFound
+                                        return Array.empty<byte>
+                                else
+                                    context.Response.StatusCode <- int HttpStatusCode.NotFound
+                                    return Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("not found")
+                            }
+
+                        context.Response.ContentType <- "application/octet-stream"
+                        context.Response.ContentLength64 <- int64 responseBytes.Length
+                        do! context.Response.OutputStream.WriteAsync(responseBytes, 0, responseBytes.Length)
+                        context.Response.Close()
+                        return! serveRequests ()
+                    with
+                    | :? HttpListenerException -> return ()
+                    | :? ObjectDisposedException -> return ()
+                }
+
+            let serving = serveRequests ()
+
+            try
+                return! action serverUri requestedPaths stash
+            finally
+                listener.Stop()
+                listener.Close()
+        }

+    static member private CreateManifestFileVersion relativePath payload (plan: LocalPlanner.LocalFilePlan) =
+        match plan.ManifestAddress with
+        | None -> failwith "Expected a manifest-backed large-content plan."
+        | Some manifestAddress ->
+            let blocks =
+                plan.Blocks
+                |> Array.map (fun block -> ContentBlock.Create(block.Address, block.Offset, block.Size))
+                |> List.ofArray
+
+            let manifest = FileManifest.Create(manifestAddress, plan.ChunkingSuiteId, plan.FileContentHash, plan.ExpectedSize, blocks)
+
+            let fileVersion = FileVersion.Create relativePath (ManifestDownloadBehaviorTests.ComputeSha256Hash payload) String.Empty true (int64 payload.Length)
+            fileVersion.ContentReference <- FileContentReference.FileManifest manifest
+            fileVersion
+
+    static member private CreateGetDownloadUriParameters fileVersion correlationId =
+        let parameters = GetDownloadUriParameters()
+        parameters.OwnerId <- "22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222"
+        parameters.OwnerName <- "owner"
+        parameters.OrganizationId <- "33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333333333"
+        parameters.OrganizationName <- "org"
+        parameters.RepositoryId <- "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"

+                |> ignore

+                    File.WriteAllText(graceConfigPath, "{}")

+                let configuration = GraceConfiguration()
+                configuration.OwnerId <- Guid.Parse("22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222")
+                configuration.OwnerName <- "owner"
+                configuration.OrganizationId <- Guid.Parse("33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333333333")
+                configuration.OrganizationName <- "org"
+                configuration.RepositoryId <- Guid.Parse("11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111")
+                configuration.RepositoryName <- "repo"

+                configuration.ObjectDirectory <- Path.Combine(configuration.GraceDirectory, Constants.GraceObjectsDirectory)

+    /// Drives the public CLI working-directory restore seam with a manifest-backed FileVersion, so implementations
+    /// wired into the CLI restore path are exercised end-to-end. Installs the manifest-backed FileVersion through the
+    /// same server-side DirectoryVersion shape that a real restore would carry.
+    static member private DriveCliRestore _serverUri (fileVersion: FileVersion) correlationId =
+        task {
+            let directoryVersionId = DirectoryVersionId.NewGuid()
+            let configuration = Current()
+
+            let directoryVersion =
+                DirectoryVersion.Create
+                    directoryVersionId
+                    (OwnerId $"{configuration.OwnerId}")
+                    (OrganizationId $"{configuration.OrganizationId}")
+                    (RepositoryId $"{configuration.RepositoryId}")
+                    Constants.RootDirectoryPath
+                    (Sha256Hash String.Empty)
+                    (List<DirectoryVersionId>())
+                    (List<FileVersion>([ fileVersion ]))
+                    fileVersion.Size
+
+            let graceStatus = GraceStatus.Default
+
+            let dto =
+                { Grace.Types.DirectoryVersion.DirectoryVersionDto.Default with
+                    DirectoryVersion = directoryVersion
+                    RecursiveSize = directoryVersion.Size
+                }

+            do! updateWorkingDirectory graceStatus graceStatus ([| dto |] :> IEnumerable<Grace.Types.DirectoryVersion.DirectoryVersionDto>) correlationId
+        }
+
+    /// Drives the pre-manifest qualified download path exactly as the base SDK dispatches it for any
+    /// FileVersion, manifest-backed or not.
+    static member private DrivePreManifestSdkDownload serverUri (fileVersion: FileVersion) correlationId =
+        task {

+
+            match downloadResult with
+            | Ok returnValue -> logToConsole $"pre-manifest SDK download completed: {returnValue.ReturnValue}"
+            | Error error -> logToConsole $"pre-manifest SDK download failed: {error.Error}"
+        }

+    /// Drives the public product download surfaces exactly as a user of Grace would reach them: the CLI
+    /// working-directory restore seam first, then the SDK object-storage download entry point, both with
+    /// the manifest-backed FileVersion intact. Whatever surface an implementation fixes is what gets
+    /// exercised; the pre-fix surfaces all resolve through the whole-file compatibility endpoint.
+    static member private DriveProductDownloadSurfaces _serverUri (fileVersion: FileVersion) correlationId =
+        task {
+            try
+                do! ManifestDownloadBehaviorTests.DriveCliRestore _serverUri fileVersion correlationId
+            with
+            | ex -> logToConsole $"CLI restore raised {ex.GetType().Name}: {ex.Message}"

+
+    /// Drives the public download surface selected by the supplied caller for a manifest-backed FileVersion and hands

+    static member private DriveManifestDownload testName (payload: byte array) (prepare: FileVersion -> IDictionary<ContentBlockAddress, byte array> -> byte array) provideStashContentBlockBytes (stashBoundaries: string list) (caller: string -> FileVersion -> string -> Task<unit>) (assertion: FileVersion -> LocalFileVersion -> ConcurrentQueue<string> -> Task<unit>) =

+                            ManifestDownloadBehaviorTests.WithContentBlockServer stagedPayload payloads provideStashContentBlockBytes stashBoundaries (fun serverUri requestedPaths _stash ->

Split clear no-Aspire server tests into Grace.Server.Unit.Tests
## Objective

Create `src/Grace.Server.Unit.Tests`, move clear no-Aspire server/unit coverage out of `src/Grace.Server.Tests`, add the new project to `src/Grace.slnx`, and make `scripts/validate.ps1 -Fast` run it.

## Context and evidence

- Parent epic: #166.
- `src/Grace.Server.Tests/Grace.Server.Tests.fsproj` currently compiles `AspireTestHost.fs`, `General.Server.Tests.fs`, HTTP integration files, and unit-shaped files in one assembly.
- The same project references `Aspire.Hosting.Testing` and `Grace.Aspire.AppHost`, which makes every test in the assembly integration-shaped even when individual tests are deterministic and no-Aspire.
- Fast validation currently excludes all server coverage because `Grace.Server.Tests` is only added for `-Full`.

## Owned paths

- `src/Grace.Server.Unit.Tests/**`
- `src/Grace.Server.Tests/Grace.Server.Tests.fsproj`
- Clear no-Aspire test files moved from `src/Grace.Server.Tests/**`
- `src/Grace.slnx`
- `scripts/validate.ps1`

## Forbidden or sensitive paths

- `src/Grace.Aspire.AppHost/**`
- `.github/workflows/**`
- Product implementation projects outside test project references unless this issue is updated first.
- `src/Grace.Server.Tests/AspireTestHost.fs` and shared integration setup files except removing compile membership is explicitly needed and justified.

## Risk surfaces

- Storage, Cosmos DB, Service Bus, Redis, or Aspire
- Server or API contract
- Orleans actor behavior
- Docs or workflow

## Validation profile

- `server-api`

## Public behavior under test

- Boundary: repository validation workflow and server test project membership.
- Behavior: `pwsh ./scripts/validate.ps1 -Fast` runs `Grace.Server.Unit.Tests` without starting Aspire, while `Grace.Server.Tests` remains Full-only.
- RED evidence expected: before implementation, `dotnet test --configuration Release --no-build src/Grace.Server.Unit.Tests/Grace.Server.Unit.Tests.fsproj` fails because the project does not exist.

## Minimum detail gate

Invariant tuple:
- Actor/workflow/test boundary: no-Aspire server tests are owned by `Grace.Server.Unit.Tests`; Aspire-backed HTTP/resource tests are owned by `Grace.Server.Tests`.
- Identity dimensions: a moved test remains the same NUnit test by name and assertion intent; a test is unit-eligible only when it has no AppHost, Aspire, HTTP endpoint, emulator, Service Bus, Redis, blob storage, or `Grace.Server.Tests.Services` dependency.
- Source of truth: `.fsproj` compile membership plus validation script project list.

Forbidden implementation shapes:
- Do not copy `Aspire.Hosting.Testing`, `Grace.Aspire.AppHost`, `AspireTestHost`, or `Grace.Server.Tests.Services` into the unit project.
- Do not delete integration tests because unit tests look similar.
- Do not rename `Grace.Server.Tests` to `Grace.Server.Integration.Tests` in this slice.
- Do not change runtime/product code to make tests compile.

Expected tests:
- Focused `dotnet test` for `Grace.Server.Unit.Tests`.
- `pwsh ./scripts/validate.ps1 -Fast` proving the new project runs in Fast.
- Negative dependency scan over `src/Grace.Server.Unit.Tests`.

High-risk adversarial examples:
- A file marked `[<Parallelizable>]` still calls HTTP or shared integration services.
- An actor-oriented test secretly depends on runtime services or AppHost transitive setup.
- A moved test disappears from both project files due to F# compile-order edits.
- Fast validation becomes Docker/Aspire-dependent through transitive references.

## Expected validation

- `dotnet tool run fantomas --check <touched F# files>` or format touched files before tests.
- `dotnet test --configuration Release --no-build src/Grace.Server.Unit.Tests/Grace.Server.Unit.Tests.fsproj`
- `pwsh ./scripts/validate.ps1 -Fast`
- Negative scan for: `Aspire.Hosting.Testing`, `Grace.Aspire.AppHost`, `AspireTestHost`, `Grace.Server.Tests.Services`, `Services.Client`, `HttpClient`, `PostAsync`, `GetAsync`, `SendAsync`, `ServiceBus`, `Azure.Storage.Blobs`, and emulator resource names.
- `git diff --check`

## Docs impact

- Create `src/Grace.Server.Unit.Tests/AGENTS.md` only if not deferred to the docs/final-audit slice.
- Note any guidance drift that Slice E must reconcile.

## Definition of done

- New project exists and builds/tests.
- New project is listed in `src/Grace.slnx`.
- Fast validation includes `Grace.Server.Unit.Tests`.
- Clear no-Aspire files are moved and remain discoverable.
- `Grace.Server.Tests` still owns integration setup and remains Full-only.
- Validation and negative-scan evidence are recorded on the PR.
- Worker commits and pushes the branch, opens a ready-for-review PR, and a fresh local review-only sibling subagent reports no issues.

### Additional contract requirements

# Test visibility scope for the server unit test project

- `src/Grace.Server.Unit.Tests/Grace.Server.Unit.Tests.fsproj` builds as a distinct test assembly named `Grace.Server.Unit.Tests`. It is a separate assembly from the existing `Grace.Server.Tests` test assembly; the moved tests execute in the new assembly, not in the old one.
- In addition to the owned paths listed in the issue, solutions are permitted to make narrowly scoped, non-runtime project metadata changes in the production project files referenced by the unit test project. Specifically, those project files may grant the `Grace.Server.Unit.Tests` test assembly friend access to their internal (non-public) surface, so that the relocated tests can compile against it. Any such entries are compile-time assembly-visibility metadata only.
- These metadata changes must not alter any runtime behavior of production code: no product source files may be modified, no runtime logic may change, and no new runtime dependencies may be introduced into production projects to make the tests compile. Production behavior changes remain prohibited.

+# Grace.Server.Unit.Tests Agents Guide
+
+Global policies live in `../AGENTS.md`; follow them before touching tests here.
+
+## Purpose
+
+- Unit, contract, determinism, and pure helper tests for server-adjacent behavior that does not boot Aspire.
+- Keep coverage here free of HTTP-hosted server calls, emulator resources, Service Bus, blob storage, Redis, and
+  `Grace.Server.Tests.Services`.
+- Move ambiguous server behavior back to `Grace.Server.Tests` unless it is clearly no-Aspire and unit-shaped.
+
+## Test File Organization
+
+- Preserve existing test names and assertion intent when moving coverage from `Grace.Server.Tests`.
+- Keep files named for the behavior under test, even when the namespace still reflects historical test ownership.
+- Do not add `AspireTestHost.fs` or references to `Grace.Aspire.AppHost`.
+
+## Validation
+
+- Run targeted Fantomas formatting or checks before build and test validation after F# changes.
+- Run `dotnet test --configuration Release --no-build src/Grace.Server.Unit.Tests/Grace.Server.Unit.Tests.fsproj`
+  after a build context exists.
+- Run `pwsh ./scripts/validate.ps1 -Fast` for the normal fast gate.

new file mode 100644
index 00000000..4f1fc3a0
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/Grace.Server.Unit.Tests/StructuralContract.Tests.fs
@@ -0,0 +1,184 @@
+namespace Grace.Server.Tests
+
+open System
+open System.Collections.Generic
+open System.Diagnostics
+open System.IO
+open System.Xml.Linq
+open NUnit.Framework
+
+/// Evaluator-owned checks for the public repository-validation contract.
+module StructuralContract =
+
+    let repositoryRoot =
+        let mutable current = DirectoryInfo(AppContext.BaseDirectory)
+
+        while (not (isNull current))
+              && not (File.Exists(Path.Combine(current.FullName, "src", "Grace.slnx"))) do
+            current <- current.Parent
+
+        if isNull current then
+            failwith "Could not locate the repository root containing src/Grace.slnx."
+
+        current.FullName
+
+    let repoPath (relativePath: string) = Path.Combine(repositoryRoot, relativePath)
+
+    let unitProjectRelativePath = "src/Grace.Server.Unit.Tests/Grace.Server.Unit.Tests.fsproj"
+
+    let unitProjectFileName = "Grace.Server.Unit.Tests.fsproj"
+
+    let serverIntegrationProjectRelativePath = "src/Grace.Server.Tests/Grace.Server.Tests.fsproj"
+
+    let forbiddenUnitProjectPatterns =
+        [
+            "Aspire.Hosting.Testing"
+            "Grace.Aspire.AppHost"
+            "AspireTestHost"
+            "Grace.Server.Tests.Services"
+            "Services.Client"
+            "HttpClient"
+            "PostAsync"
+            "GetAsync"
+            "SendAsync"
+            "ServiceBus"
+            "Azure.Storage.Blobs"
+        ]
+
+    let slnxListsUnitProject () =
+        let document = XDocument.Load(repoPath "src/Grace.slnx")
+
+        document.Descendants(XName.Get "Project")
+        |> Seq.choose (fun element ->
+            let path = element.Attribute(XName.Get "Path")
+            if isNull path then None else Some path.Value)
+        |> Seq.exists (fun path ->
+            let normalized = path.Replace('\\', '/')
+            normalized.EndsWith("/" + unitProjectFileName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
+            || String.Equals(normalized, unitProjectFileName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
+
+    /// Runs validation against a harmless dotnet recorder.  This exercises the
+    /// script's project selection without building or recursively running this
+    /// test project.
+    let runValidationWithRecordedDotnet (mode: string) =
+        let recorderDirectory =
+            Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "grace-validation-recorder-" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N"))
+
+        Directory.CreateDirectory(recorderDirectory) |> ignore
+
+        let recorderPath = Path.Combine(recorderDirectory, "dotnet")
+        File.WriteAllText(recorderPath, "#!/bin/sh\nprintf 'DOTNET_ARGUMENTS:'\nprintf ' %s' \"$@\"\nprintf '\\n'\nexit 0\n")
+
+        let chmod = ProcessStartInfo(FileName = "/bin/chmod", UseShellExecute = false)
+        chmod.ArgumentList.Add("+x")
+        chmod.ArgumentList.Add(recorderPath)
+
+        use chmodProcess = Process.Start(chmod)
+        chmodProcess.WaitForExit()
+
+        if chmodProcess.ExitCode <> 0 then
+            failwith "Could not make the validation dotnet recorder executable."
+
+        try
+            let startInfo =
+                ProcessStartInfo(
+                    FileName = "pwsh",
+                    WorkingDirectory = repositoryRoot,
+                    RedirectStandardOutput = true,
+                    RedirectStandardError = true,
+                    UseShellExecute = false
+                )
+
+            startInfo.ArgumentList.Add("-NoProfile")
+            startInfo.ArgumentList.Add("-NonInteractive")
+            startInfo.ArgumentList.Add("-ExecutionPolicy")
+            startInfo.ArgumentList.Add("Bypass")
+            startInfo.ArgumentList.Add("-File")
+            startInfo.ArgumentList.Add(repoPath "scripts/validate.ps1")
+            startInfo.ArgumentList.Add("-SkipBuild")
+            startInfo.ArgumentList.Add("-SkipFormat")
+            startInfo.ArgumentList.Add(mode)
+
+            let existingPath = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("PATH")
+            startInfo.Environment["PATH"] <- recorderDirectory + string Path.PathSeparator + existingPath
+
+            use processHandle = Process.Start(startInfo)
+            let standardOutput = processHandle.StandardOutput.ReadToEndAsync()
+            let standardError = processHandle.StandardError.ReadToEndAsync()
+            processHandle.WaitForExit()
+
+            processHandle.ExitCode, String.Concat(standardOutput.Result, "\n", standardError.Result)
+        finally
+            Directory.Delete(recorderDirectory, true)
+
+[<TestFixture>]
+[<NonParallelizable>]
+type StructuralContractTests() =
+
+    [<Test>]
+    member _.UnitTestProjectIsListedInGraceSlnx() =
+        Assert.That(
+            StructuralContract.slnxListsUnitProject (),
+            Is.True,
+            "src/Grace.slnx must list Grace.Server.Unit.Tests as a project."
+        )
+
+    [<Test>]
+    member _.FastValidationRunsUnitTestProject() =
+        let exitCode, output = StructuralContract.runValidationWithRecordedDotnet "-Fast"
+
+        Assert.That(exitCode, Is.EqualTo(0), "Fast validation must complete successfully.\nOutput:\n" + output)
+
+        Assert.That(
+            output.Contains("test " + StructuralContract.unitProjectRelativePath, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase),
+            Is.True,
+            "Fast validation must run the Grace.Server.Unit.Tests project.\nOutput:\n" + output
+        )
+
+        Assert.That(
+            output.Contains("test " + StructuralContract.serverIntegrationProjectRelativePath, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase),
+            Is.False,
+            "Fast validation must not run the Aspire-backed Grace.Server.Tests project.\nOutput:\n" + output
+        )
+
+    [<Test>]
+    member _.ServerTestsRemainFullOnly() =
+        let exitCode, output = StructuralContract.runValidationWithRecordedDotnet "-Full"
+
+        Assert.That(exitCode, Is.EqualTo(0), "Full validation must complete successfully.\nOutput:\n" + output)
+
+        Assert.That(
+            output.Contains("test " + StructuralContract.serverIntegrationProjectRelativePath, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase),
+            Is.True,
+            "Full validation must run the Aspire-backed Grace.Server.Tests project.\nOutput:\n" + output
+        )
+
+    [<Test>]
+    member _.UnitTestProjectAvoidsAspireHostingHttpAndResourceDependencies() =
+        let directory = StructuralContract.repoPath "src/Grace.Server.Unit.Tests"
+
+        let sourceFiles =
+            Directory.GetFiles(directory, "*", SearchOption.AllDirectories)
+            |> Array.filter (fun path ->
+                not (String.Equals(Path.GetFileName(path), "StructuralContract.Tests.fs", StringComparison.Ordinal))
+                && (path.EndsWith(".fs", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
+                    || path.EndsWith(".fsproj", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
+            |> Array.sort
+
+        Assert.That(sourceFiles, Is.Not.Empty, "The unit test project directory must contain F# sources.")
+
+        let forbiddenHits =
+            [
+                for path in sourceFiles do
+                    let text = File.ReadAllText(path)
+
+                    for pattern in StructuralContract.forbiddenUnitProjectPatterns do
+                        if text.Contains(pattern, StringComparison.Ordinal) then
+                            Path.GetFileName(path), pattern
+            ]
+
+        Assert.That(
+            forbiddenHits,
+            Is.Empty,
+            "The unit test project must not reference Aspire hosting, HTTP clients, Service Bus, blob storage, or shared integration services."
+        )
